</record>
<record session="session_17" date="2:34 pm on 10 July, 2022" dialogue_ids="D17:3 D17:4">
Nate: Thanks, Joanna! Your support means a lot to me. That road trip sounds great! Where did you go? Did you discover any interesting places?
Joanna: Thanks Nate! Appreciate your kind words. I went to Woodhaven, a small town in the Midwest. Got to see some lovely scenery and historic buildings. Checked out the library there, it had a cool old book collection!
</record>
<record session="session_20" date="6:03 pm on 5 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D20:3 D20:4">
Nate: Hey Joanna, yeah it's a bummer that I didn't do well. But it's all part of the learning curve, you know? Also that looks super good! Anyways, how are you holding up?
Joanna: I'm doing OK, thanks. Just been tinkering with that recipe and a few others. It's helping me find some comfort and getting creative.
</record>
<record session="session_20" date="6:03 pm on 5 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D20:5 D20:6">
Nate: What else are you making? It's always satisfying to see the kind of things you do when your in one of those moods!
Joanna: Been tweaking a dessert recipe to make it yummier and more accessible.
</record>
<record session="session_20" date="6:03 pm on 5 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D20:7 D20:8">
Nate: Wow, that sounds great! What flavors are you experimenting with?
Joanna: Trying out different flavors like chocolate, raspberry, and coconut has been a blast!
</record>
<record session="session_20" date="6:03 pm on 5 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D20:9 D20:10">
Nate: Sounds delicious! Are you only trying dairy-free options?
Joanna: Yeah, since I'm lactose intolerant I'm trying out dairy-free options like coconut or almond milk instead. It's been a fun challenge seeing how to make yummy treats that suit everyone's diets. I even made these dairy-free chocolate coconut cupcakes with raspberry frosting.
</record>
<record session="session_20" date="6:03 pm on 5 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D20:11 D20:12">
Nate: Woah, those look great, Joanna! It's cool that you make desserts that work for everyone's diets. Do you have any more yummy recipes hiding in there?
Joanna: Yep! I've been making all sorts of desserts that work for everyone's diets - cookies, pies, cakes - everything! I'll share more recipes with you soon.
</record>
<record session="session_20" date="6:03 pm on 5 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D20:13 D20:14">
Nate: Can't wait to try them. Can I join you sometime? I think baking and cooking really brings us together!
Joanna: Yeah, Nate! A fellow Chef in the kitchen is always a great help! Speaking of which, i'm curious, any more tips for dairy-free baking?
</record>
<record session="session_20" date="6:03 pm on 5 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D20:15 D20:16">
Nate: You can use stuff like dairy-free margarine or coconut oil instead of butter, and make sure to check the labels to ensure they're dairy-free. Good luck!
Joanna: Thanks, Nate! Love your ideas, can't wait to try them out!
</record>
<record session="session_20" date="6:03 pm on 5 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D20:17 D20:18">
Nate: No problem! I love to help, so just shoot me a question anytime you need!
Joanna: Got it Nate, I'll see you soon!
</record>
<record session="session_20" date="6:03 pm on 5 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D20:19">
Nate: Bye Joanna! Good luck!
</record>
<record session="session_21" date="1:43 pm on 14 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D21:1 D21:2">
Joanna: Hey Nate, long time no see! My laptop crashed last week and I lost all my work - super frustrating! As a writer, my laptop is like half of my lifeline so losing all progress was like a major blow.
Nate: Hey Joanna, sorry to hear about that. Losing so much progress must be really frustrating. Did you manage to recover anything? Maybe consider backing up your work in the future?
</record>
<record session="session_21" date="1:43 pm on 14 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D21:3 D21:4">
Joanna: Thanks for the sympathy, Nate. Nothing was recoverable, but now I have an external drive for backups. I never want to go through this again. So, how have you been? Making anything cool?
Nate: Hey Joanna, I'm no writer like you, but something pretty awesome happened. Last Monday I got to teach people vegan ice cream recipes on my own cooking show! It was a bit nerve-wracking to put myself out there, but it was a blast. Plus, I picked up a few new recipes!
</record>
<record session="session_21" date="1:43 pm on 14 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D21:5 D21:6">
Joanna: Way to go, Nate! Congrats on the cooking show, I'll definitely be tuning in! What's your favorite dish from the show?
Nate: Coconut milk ice cream is at the top of my list. It's so smooth and creamy with a tropical coconut twist. Plus, it's dairy-free for people who can't have lactose or who want vegan options. Here's a snap of the ice cream I made.
</record>
<record session="session_21" date="1:43 pm on 14 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D21:7 D21:8">
Joanna: Wow, that looks amazing, Nate! I love the color and texture. It's great that you're making these options. Could you share the recipe? I'd love to try making it sometime!
Nate: Yeah sure! Would love to share it. Let's spread the joy of dairy-free options! Let me know when you make it!
</record>
<record session="session_21" date="1:43 pm on 14 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D21:9 D21:10">
Joanna: Cool, Nate! Gonna give it a go. Dairy-free is a must for me, especially for desserts. Last Friday, I made a deeeelish dessert with almond milk - it was good! Got any favs when it comes to dairy-free desserts?
Nate: Coconut milk ice cream is one of my favorites as you might be able to tell, but I also love a dairy-free chocolate mousse. It's super creamy and tastes like the real thing. What's been your favorite dairy-free sweet treat so far?
</record>
<record session="session_21" date="1:43 pm on 14 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D21:11 D21:12">
Joanna: Hey Nate, my favorite dairy-free treat is this amazing chocolate raspberry tart. It has an almond flour crust, chocolate ganache, and fresh raspberries - it's delicious!
Nate: That looks amazing, Joanna! I need to try baking that. What other treats do you like making?
</record>
<record session="session_21" date="1:43 pm on 14 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D21:13 D21:14">
Joanna: Hey Nate, I love making this dairy-free chocolate cake with raspberries. It's so moist and delicious - perfect sweetness level.
Nate: That cake looks amazing, Joanna! How did you make it?
</record>
<record session="session_21" date="1:43 pm on 14 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D21:15 D21:16">
Joanna: I make it with almond flour, coconut oil, chocolate and raspberries. It's my favorite for birthdays and special days.
Nate: Yum, Joanna! Gotta try that one. Any others you want to share?
</record>
<record session="session_21" date="1:43 pm on 14 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D21:17 D21:18">
Joanna: Hey Nate! Here's another recipe I like. It's a delicious dessert made with blueberries, coconut milk, and a gluten-free crust. So creamy and delicious!
Nate: Wow, Joanna! That dessert looks amazing. I'll definitely have to give it a try. Thanks!
</record>
<record session="session_21" date="1:43 pm on 14 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D21:19 D21:20">
Joanna: Glad to help, Nate. Let me know if you try it. I'm sure you'll enjoy it. It was great chatting.
Nate: Thanks Joanna! I will. Bye!
</record>
<record session="session_22" date="11:15 am on 6 October, 2022" dialogue_ids="D22:1 D22:2">
Joanna: Hey Nate, hi! Yesterday, I tried my newest dairy-free recipe and it was a winner with my family! Mixing and matching flavors is fun and I'm always trying new things. How about you?
Nate: Hey Joanna! That tart looks yummy! Lately, I've been doing great - I won a really big video game tournament last week and it was awesome! I still can't believe I made so much money from it.
</record>
<record session="session_22" date="11:15 am on 6 October, 2022" dialogue_ids="D22:3 D22:4">
Joanna: Way to go, Nate! Winning the tournament and earning cash is awesome - congrats! Did you save it for something special?
Nate: Thanks Joanna! Yeah, I saved some but I'm not sure what to do with it - I'm completely content already. I don't have big plans anyway, so it's nice to have the extra cash on hand.
</record>
<record session="session_26" date="3:56 pm on 4 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D26:1 D26:2">
Joanna: Wow, Nate, I'm on fire! I just set up meetings with movie producers — my dreams are comin' true!
Nate: Wow Joanna, nice work! How did it go with those producer meetings?
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:1 D28:2">
Nate: Hey Joanna, what a wild week! My game tournament got pushed back, so I tried out some cooking. Look at this homemade coconut ice cream! The sprinkles kinda changed the color this time around.
Joanna: Hey Nate, that looks yummy! Wish I could try it, but I can't right now. How did the last game tournament go?
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:11 D28:12">
Nate: Anytime. What're you working on in that notebook? Anything cool?
Joanna: Hey Nate, I'm working on a new project - a suspenseful thriller set in a small Midwestern town. It's been a great creative outlet for me. How about you? Do you have any projects you're working on?
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:54 pm on 9 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D28:21 D28:22">
Nate: Wow, that sunset pic looks incredible! What inspired you to take that photo?
Joanna: Thanks, Nate! I took that pic on a hike last summer near Fort Wayne. The sunset and the surrounding beauty were just incredible. It was an awesome reminder of nature's beauty.
</record>
<record session="session_29" date="12:06 am on 11 November, 2022" dialogue_ids="D29:5 D29:6">
Joanna: One of the actors came up to me and told me how much she liked my script! I was so excited when that happened - it gave me chills!
Nate: Wow Joanna, that must have been so exciting! It's incredible when you get those moments of joy. Anyway, I took my turtles to the beach in Tampa yesterday! They always bring me peace in the craziness of life.
</record>

<record session="session_18" date="6:12 pm on 14 August, 2022" dialogue_ids="D18:5 D18:6">
Joanna: Yep. Last week, someone wrote me a letter after reading an online blog post I made about a hard moment in my life. Their words touched me; they said my story had brought them comfort. It was awesome to realize my words had that kind of power. It reminded me why I love writing.

</record>

<record session="session_18" date="6:12 pm on 14 August, 2022" dialogue_ids="D18:13 D18:14">

<record session="session_18" date="6:12 pm on 14 August, 2022" dialogue_ids="D18:15 D18:16">

</record>
<record session="session_19" date="10:57 am on 22 August, 2022" dialogue_ids="D19:1 D19:2">

Joanna: Congrats, Nate! So proud of you for winning that tournament, that's awesome! Must feel great to turn your passion into a career.
</record>
<record session="session_19" date="10:57 am on 22 August, 2022" dialogue_ids="D19:3 D19:4">

Joanna: Wow Nate, they're adorable! I can see why you enjoy spending time with them. It looks like they have so much more room to swim now!
</record>
<record session="session_19" date="10:57 am on 22 August, 2022" dialogue_ids="D19:5 D19:6">
Nate: They're my little buddies, always calm and peaceful. It makes coming home after a long day of gaming better. The tank expansion has made them so happy! How have you been?
Joanna: I'm good! Was super nervous last week when I shared my book with my writers group but got some great feedback. My hard work is paying off, it's such an awesome feeling!
</record>
<record session="session_19" date="10:57 am on 22 August, 2022" dialogue_ids="D19:7 D19:8">
Nate: Wow Jo, you're killing it! Getting this kind of feedback means people are really connecting with your writing. Pretty cool! Did you celebrate?
Joanna: Thanks, Nate! It feels great knowing that people like my writing. I celebrated by making this delicious treat - yum! Any plans for the weekend?
</record>
<record session="session_19" date="10:57 am on 22 August, 2022" dialogue_ids="D19:9 D19:10">
Nate: I'm taking some time off this weekend to chill with my pets. Anything cool happening with you?
Joanna: I'm relaxing and recharging this weekend with a long walk and some reading. It's a good break.
</record>
<record session="session_19" date="10:57 am on 22 August, 2022" dialogue_ids="D19:11 D19:12">
Nate: Looks like we both need a break. I'm glad your able to find a way to recharge! It's so incredibly important to take time off!
Joanna: Thanks, Nate! I've learned that taking breaks and looking after myself are important for my inspiration and mental health. It's all about finding balance.
</record>
<record session="session_19" date="10:57 am on 22 August, 2022" dialogue_ids="D19:13 D19:14">
Nate: Yeah, balance is key! It's so cool how taking care of ourselves helps us be more creative and happier. I'm always looking for something new to read. Got any book recommendations? I've got a lot of books to choose from.
Joanna: I reccomend finding a fantasy book series to read through. Most fiction series are great reads when your trying to relax.
</record>
<record session="session_19" date="10:57 am on 22 August, 2022" dialogue_ids="D19:15 D19:16">
Nate: Good idea! How about this series?
Joanna: That's a great one! Let me know what you think when your finished!
</record>
<record session="session_19" date="10:57 am on 22 August, 2022" dialogue_ids="D19:17 D19:18">
Nate: Sure thing! And since your recommending me a book, I thought I should do the same! I'd really recommend this series. It's got awesome battles and interesting characters.
Joanna: Wow, that series looks awesome! I'll have to check it out sometime!
</record>
<record session="session_19" date="10:57 am on 22 August, 2022" dialogue_ids="D19:19 D19:20">
Nate: You really should! The action scenes are awesome and the plot rocks. Definitely one of my favorites!
Joanna: Wow, sounds great! I'll definitely add it to my list; thanks for the recommendation!
</record>
<record session="session_19" date="10:57 am on 22 August, 2022" dialogue_ids="D19:21 D19:22">
Nate: Enjoy it! Have a good day.
Joanna: Thanks, Nate! You too! Have a great day. Take care.
</record>
<record session="session_20" date="6:03 pm on 5 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D20:1 D20:2">

Speaking of which, I just had a letdown in a video game tourney - I didn't do too great, even though I tried. It was a setback, but I'm trying to stay positive.

<record session="session_20" date="6:03 pm on 5 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D20:3 D20:4">

</record>
<record session="session_20" date="6:03 pm on 5 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D20:5 D20:6">

<record session="session_20" date="6:03 pm on 5 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D20:7 D20:8">

<record session="session_3" date="4:21 pm on 16 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D3:33 D3:34">

Tim: Sure thing! It's what makes life awesome!
</record>
<record session="session_3" date="4:21 pm on 16 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D3:35">
John: Yeah. Awesome catching up! Bye!
</record>

</record>

<record session="session_4" date="4:17 pm on 2 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:7 D4:8">

<record session="session_4" date="4:17 pm on 2 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:9 D4:10">

</record>
<record session="session_4" date="4:17 pm on 2 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:11 D4:12">

</record>
<record session="session_4" date="4:17 pm on 2 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:13 D4:14">
Tim: Same here!
John: Have fun with your writing! Catch you later!
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="4:17 pm on 2 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:15">
Tim: Thanks! I'll enjoy writing them. Take care and talk soon!
</record>

</record>
<record session="session_21" date="5:34 pm on 6 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D21:5 D21:6">

</record>
<record session="session_21" date="5:34 pm on 6 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D21:7 D21:8">

John: Yup, on the court, I'm getting better at my overall game. Money-wise, I've gotten some cool endorsement deals. Plus, I'm learning how to market myself and boost my brand. It's been really rewarding to see all these areas progress. What about you? Anything new happening?
</record>
<record session="session_21" date="5:34 pm on 6 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D21:9 D21:10">
Tim: Joined a travel club and, like I said, working on studies. Also picked up new skills. Recently started learning an instrument. Challenging but fun, always admired musicians. Finally giving it a go.
John: Learning an instrument is really cool. What instrument are you playing? What genres of music do you want to learn?
</record>
<record session="session_21" date="5:34 pm on 6 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D21:11 D21:12">
Tim: I'm learning how to play the violin now. I'm mostly into classical music but I'm keen to try out jazz and film scores too. It's a great way to chill and get creative.
John: Wow! I hope I can hear you play the violin some day. How long have you been playing the piano again?
</record>
<record session="session_21" date="5:34 pm on 6 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D21:13 D21:14">
Tim: I've been playing for about four months now and it's been an amazing adventure. I'm really enjoying the progress I've been making.
John: Nice one! Learning something new is always a great adventure. Keep up the hard work and let's see where you end up. It's all about dedication and effort. It feels great to finally achieve something after putting in so much time and energy.
</record>
<record session="session_21" date="5:34 pm on 6 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D21:15 D21:16">
Tim: Congrats on the trophy! It must have felt great to finally get something after putting in so much effort. Do you have any tips on motivating others on your team?
John: Thanks! Winning was awesome. When motivating others, it's important to show care for teammates, celebrate their achievements, provide constructive feedback, and remind them of the bigger goal. Creating a positive environment and giving a pep talk before a game can also be helpful. It's all about supporting and uplifting each other. Do you have any specific strategies in mind?
</record>
<record session="session_21" date="5:34 pm on 6 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D21:17 D21:18">
Tim: Thanks for the helpful advice. Creating a constructive atmosphere and setting an example by working hard can really inspire people. It’s also inspiring to use our own stories to encourage others. Much appreciated!
John: No problem! It's great to use our own experiences to inspire others. Hard work can lead to success. Keep it up! Let me know if you need any assistance.
</record>
<record session="session_21" date="5:34 pm on 6 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D21:19">
Tim: Thanks! Appreciate the offer. Let me know if you can lend a hand. Bye!
</record>
<record session="session_22" date="7:42 pm on 8 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D22:1 D22:2">
Tim: Hey John! Long time no see! I just got back from the coolest Harry Potter party. Met lots of awesome people who were into the same stuff as me, had so much fun!
John: Hey Tim! Sounds awesome! So glad you had a blast at the Harry Potter party. Last August I told you about my fun time at a charity event with Harry Potter trivia. Love being with people who are as passionate about Harry Potter as us! Did you dress up as any character?
</record>
<record session="session_22" date="7:42 pm on 8 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D22:3 D22:4">
Tim: It was awesome. I didn't dress as any character, but I wore my Gryffindor scarf. Everyone had cool costumes. I even got this as a treat. Any recent meet-ups with your basketball team?
John: That frog looks yummy! I haven't had one in ages. Been having some wild games lately, we played a top team and it was tough, but we fought hard and got the win! It's awesome having my team to push us all.
</record>
<record session="session_22" date="7:42 pm on 8 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D22:5 D22:6">
Tim: Wow, looks fun! What was the best part for you? And congratulations on the win!
John: Thanks! The best part for me was the camaraderie we built both on and off the court. Winning felt amazing and it was definitely worth all the hard work we put in.
</record>
<record session="session_22" date="7:42 pm on 8 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D22:7 D22:8">
Tim: Wow, that's awesome! It's great to see how close you all have become. You must feel a great sense of unity. I'm reading this amazing series about the power of friendship and loyalty – really inspiring stuff. Anything special you do to keep that bond strong?
John: Sounds awesome! What kind of stuff do they do in the series? I'm sure the importance of friendship is emphasized. Same with us - we have team dinners, outings, and basketball games. It's those moments away from practice that really build and strengthen our unity.
</record>
<record session="session_22" date="7:42 pm on 8 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D22:9 D22:10">
Tim: Awesome! Sounds like your team has something similar to the characters in the series. They rely on each other to push through challenges. By the way, what book are you currently reading? I'm always on the lookout for new reads!
John: Thanks! I'm currently reading a book that I really enjoy. I highly recommend it!
</record>
<record session="session_26" date="3:35 pm on 26 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D26:25 D26:26">
John: Thanks! I'm really glad I can make a difference. Have you been doing anything new in your free time?
Tim: In my downtime, I still love to get lost in good books, and this series is one of my favorites. It's a magical world to escape to.
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:24 pm on 7 January, 2024" dialogue_ids="D28:1 D28:2">
Tim: Hey John, long time no talk. On Friday, I got great news - I'm finally in the study abroad program I applied for! Next month, I'm off to Ireland for a semester.
John: Congrats, Tim! That's amazing news. So, where are you going to stay?
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:24 pm on 7 January, 2024" dialogue_ids="D28:21">
Tim: No problem. Talk to you soon!
</record>

John: Hey Tim, nice to meet you! What's up? Anything new happening?
Tim: Hey John! Great to meet you. Been discussing collaborations for a Harry Potter fan project I am working on - super excited! Anything interesting happening for you?
</record>

</record>
<record session="session_1" date="7:48 pm on 21 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:5 D1:6">

Tim: Cool! What position are you playing for the team? Any exciting games coming up?
</record>
<record session="session_1" date="7:48 pm on 21 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:7 D1:8">

Tim: Cool! Have any goals in mind?
</record>
<record session="session_1" date="7:48 pm on 21 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:9 D1:10">

Tim: Sounds good! What challenges have you encountered during your pre-season training?
</record>
<record session="session_1" date="7:48 pm on 21 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:11 D1:12">

Tim: That sounds rough. How are things going with the new team?
</record>
<record session="session_1" date="7:48 pm on 21 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:13 D1:14">
John: Things are going well! The team has been really nice and I'm having fun. How's your fan project coming along?
Tim: It's been going well! Last week I talked to my friend who is a fan of Harry Potter and we're figuring out ideas, so it's been great to get lost in that magical world!
</record>
<record session="session_1" date="7:48 pm on 21 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:15 D1:16">
John: That's great! Loving it when people are passionate about their work. What kind of collaborations are you involved in for the fan project? I love talking to people about my sneaker collection.
Tim: Thanks! We'll be discussing various aspects of the Harry Potter universe, like characters, spells, and magical creatures. It's great to see fans coming together for this.
</record>
<record session="session_1" date="7:48 pm on 21 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:17 D1:18">
John: Wow! Have you been to any places related to it?
Tim: I went to a place in London a few years ago - it was like walking into a Harry Potter movie! I also went on a tour which was amazing. Have you been to any of the real Potter places? I'd love to explore them someday!
</record>
<record session="session_1" date="7:48 pm on 21 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:19 D1:20">
John: No, but it sounds fun! Going to those places is definitely on my to-do list.
Tim: Definitely add it to your list! It's a really fun experience. Let me know if you need any tips for visiting. Bye!
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="5:08 pm on 15 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:1 D2:2">
Tim: Last night I joined a fantasy literature forum and had a great talk about my fave books. It was so enriching!
John: Wow, great to hear that you had a blast talking books! It's cool to connect with others who share your passion. On a different note, exciting things are happening--I'm exploring endorsement opportunities. Thinking about the possibilities pumps me up. It would be amazing to work with brands and do something special. It's so rewarding to have my hard work pay off like this.
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="5:08 pm on 15 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:3 D2:4">
Tim: Wow, that's awesome! Congrats - you must be so stoked! Which brands are you looking to link up with?
John: Thanks! I'm really excited about this new journey! I'm currently considering sports brands like Nike and Under Armour. It would be great to collaborate with brands that are related to sports. However, I'm also open to exploring other brands that align with my values and interests. There are so many options out there, and I can't wait to see where this takes me!
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="5:08 pm on 15 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:5 D2:6">
Tim: That's awesome! It's gotta be a rush having all these options. Can't wait to see which brands you choose to work with - gonna be great!
John: Thanks! Exciting times ahead! I'll keep you updated on which brands I choose. Can't wait to see where this journey leads me. Thanks for your support.
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="5:08 pm on 15 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:7 D2:8">
Tim: Yeah, John! Count on me for support. Can't wait to see what's up! This is my book collection so far.
John: Wow, nice bookshelf! That picture is really interesting. What's up with it?
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="5:08 pm on 15 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:9 D2:10">
Tim: Thanks! That picture is from MinaLima. They created all the props for the Harry Potter films, and I love their work. It's like having a piece of the wizarding world at home!
John: Wow, having that is so cool! Your enthusiasm for it is awesome. You really go for it!
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="5:08 pm on 15 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:11 D2:12">
Tim: Thanks! I have lots of reminders of it - kind of a way to escape reality.
John: Do those reminders help you escape the daily grind? Any chance you'll visit more places related to that world soon?
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="5:08 pm on 15 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:13 D2:14">
Tim: Definitely, those reminders really help. And there's definitely a chance I'll be visiting more HP spots in the future. It feels like I'm stepping into the books!
John: That sounds awesome! So cool that you get to immerse yourself in that world. So glad you found something that brings you so much joy. Keep diving in and enjoying it! Here's a pic from a recent game.
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="5:08 pm on 15 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:15 D2:16">
Tim: Wow! That's awesome! Were you playing or watching?
John: Thanks! That was from a game I just played. I was in it! It was awesome being out there, doing what I love. Such an awesome feeling.
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="5:08 pm on 15 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:17 D2:18">
Tim: Wow! You look so into it in that pic – it must be so awesome playing at that level! Keep rockin' it!
John: Thanks! It's a blast. Giving it my all every time I'm on the court. Really appreciate your support!
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="5:08 pm on 15 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:19">
Tim: Yeah, keep going! Don't give up on your dreams. Talk to you later!
</record>
<record session="session_3" date="4:21 pm on 16 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D3:1 D3:2">
John: Hey Tim! Good to see you again. So much has happened in the last month - on and off the court. Last week I scored 40 points, my highest ever, and it feels like all my hard work's paying off.
Tim: Congrats on your achievement! I'm so proud of you. Last week, I had a nice chat with a Harry Potter fan in California. It was magical!
</record>
<record session="session_3" date="4:21 pm on 16 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D3:3 D3:4">
John: Thank you! Scoring those points was an incredible experience. The atmosphere was electric, and my teammates and I were thrilled. We pulled off a tough win!
Tim: Wow, sounds awesome! Winning after that game must have felt amazing - what was it like? Did you celebrate afterward?
</record>

<record session="session_10" date="2:52 pm on 31 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D10:11 D10:12">

John: Hey Tim! Great to hear from you. Learning about different cultures and seeing historical architecture fascinates me. Visiting castles is really on my bucket list. <record session="session_19" date="10:22 am on 21 November, 2023" dialogue_ids="D19:13 D19:14">

<record session="session_20" date="9:52 am on 1 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D20:17 D20:18">

<record session="session_1" date="7:48 pm on 21 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:1 D1:2">
John: Hey Tim, nice to meet you! What's up? Anything new happening?
Tim: Hey John! Great to meet you. Been discussing collaborations for a Harry Potter fan project I am working on - super excited! Anything interesting happening for you?
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="4:17 pm on 2 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:15">
Tim: Thanks! I'll enjoy writing them. Take care and talk soon!
</record>
<record session="session_7" date="7:54 pm on 17 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:5 D7:6">
John: Cool! It's great when you find a group that appreciates the same things. It really adds something special to our lives. So, do you have any exciting plans or events coming up?
Tim: I have no big events coming up, but I'm hoping to attend a book conference next month. It's an interesting gathering of authors, publishers and book lovers where we talk about our favorite novels and new releases. I'm excited to go because it'll help me learn more about literature and create a stronger bond to it.
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="4:29 pm on 21 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:11 D8:12">
John: Thanks! Appreciate your support. It's been a journey, but I'm happy with the progress. Excited to see what's next. What about you? How have you been?
Tim: Things have been great since we last talked - I've been focusing on school and reading a bunch of fantasy books. It's a nice way to take a break from all the stress. I've also started learning how to play the piano - it's a learning curve, but it's so satisfying seeing the progress I make! Life's good.
</record>
<record session="session_9" date="6:59 pm on 26 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D9:5 D9:6">
Tim: Nope, never been on a sports team. I'm more into reading and fantasy novels. I love sinking into different magical worlds. It's one of the reasons I love traveling to new places, to experience a different kind of magic.
John: Wow, Tim, that's an awesome book collection! It's cool to escape to different worlds with a hobby. By the way, I love discovering new cities - check out this pic from one of my trips to New York City!
</record>
<record session="session_10" date="2:52 pm on 31 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D10:3 D10:4">
Tim: Thanks! Appreciate your encouragement. Yesterday, I tackled something new - I gave a presentation in class. I was nervous but I made it. Small step, but feels like progress.
John: Cool, Tim! Taking the plunge and presenting can be tough, but awesome work! Progress is progress, keep it up. By the way, I've been trying out cooking recipes. Made this tasty soup recently - it was real good!
</record>
<record session="session_10" date="2:52 pm on 31 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D10:17">
Tim: Take care! Can't wait to catch up. Talk soon!
</record>
<record session="session_11" date="8:17 pm on 21 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D11:7 D11:8">
John: We're planning to take a team trip next month to explore a new city and have some fun. Can't wait!
Tim: That sounds great! Exploring new cities is always so much fun. Where are you headed?
</record>
<record session="session_12" date="3:00 pm on 2 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D12:29">
Tim: Cool! It's great to find something you enjoy doing. Keep going for it! See ya later!
</record>
<record session="session_17" date="3:36 pm on 11 November, 2023" dialogue_ids="D17:1 D17:2">
John: Hey Tim! Great to chat again. So much has happened!
Tim: Hey John! Great chatting with you as always. What's been happening lately? I've been reading as usual.
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="3:59 pm on 16 November, 2023" dialogue_ids="D18:3 D18:4">
Tim: Ouch, bummer about the injury. Hang tight. This week has been swamped with exams for me but I'm plowing through.
John: Cheers, Tim. Injury's been rough, but I'm staying positive. How's the exam prep coming? Confident?
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="3:59 pm on 16 November, 2023" dialogue_ids="D18:15">
Tim: Take care! Keep pushing on. Talk soon.
</record>
<record session="session_21" date="5:34 pm on 6 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D21:1 D21:2">
Tim: Hey John! Haven't talked in a few days, wanted to let you know I joined a travel club! Always been interested in different cultures and countries and I'm excited to check it out. Can't wait to meet new people and learn about what makes them unique!
John: Hey Tim! That's cool! I love learning about different cultures. It's really cool to meet people with different backgrounds. My teammates come from all over.
</record>
<record session="session_21" date="5:34 pm on 6 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D21:9 D21:10">
Tim: Joined a travel club and, like I said, working on studies. Also picked up new skills. Recently started learning an instrument. Challenging but fun, always admired musicians. Finally giving it a go.
John: Learning an instrument is really cool. What instrument are you playing? What genres of music do you want to learn?
</record>
<record session="session_21" date="5:34 pm on 6 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D21:11 D21:12">
Tim: I'm learning how to play the violin now. I'm mostly into classical music but I'm keen to try out jazz and film scores too. It's a great way to chill and get creative.
John: Wow! I hope I can hear you play the violin some day. How long have you been playing the piano again?
</record>
<record session="session_21" date="5:34 pm on 6 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D21:13 D21:14">
Tim: I've been playing for about four months now and it's been an amazing adventure. I'm really enjoying the progress I've been making.
John: Nice one! Learning something new is always a great adventure. Keep up the hard work and let's see where you end up. It's all about dedication and effort. It feels great to finally achieve something after putting in so much time and energy.
</record>
<record session="session_22" date="7:42 pm on 8 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D22:1 D22:2">
Tim: Hey John! Long time no see! I just got back from the coolest Harry Potter party. Met lots of awesome people who were into the same stuff as me, had so much fun!
John: Hey Tim! Sounds awesome! So glad you had a blast at the Harry Potter party. Last August I told you about my fun time at a charity event with Harry Potter trivia. Love being with people who are as passionate about Harry Potter as us! Did you dress up as any character?
</record>
<record session="session_24" date="3:37 pm on 16 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D24:19 D24:20">
Tim: I'm glad everyone had fun!
John: Me too. Talk to you later!
</record>
<record session="session_25" date="10:04 am on 19 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D25:1 D25:2">
Tim: Hey John, been a while since we chatted. How's it going?
John: Yo Tim! Great to hear from you. Things have been wild! Last week I got this amazing deal with a renowned outdoor gear company. So pumped!
</record>
<record session="session_25" date="10:04 am on 19 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D25:3 D25:4">
Tim: That's awesome about the deal! I'm curious, what kind of gear did you end up getting? And how did the photoshoot turn out?
John: Cheers! Got some awesome hiking stuff and outdoor gear - all top-notch. The photoshoot went really well too. We did it in a gorgeous forest and the photographer got some epic shots of me doing my thing - it was amazing!
</record>
<record session="session_25" date="10:04 am on 19 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D25:5 D25:6">
Tim: Wow! That sounds amazing. Being out in such a gorgeous location must have been incredible. I'd love to see one of the epic shots you got! Do you have any pictures from the photoshoot?
John: Here you go, here's a pic. Nature puts me in a great mood and always gets me energized!
</record>
<record session="session_25" date="10:04 am on 19 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D25:7 D25:8">
Tim: That's an amazing photo! I can see why it inspires you - the rocks and river look so peaceful. What drew you to that spot?
John: I stumbled across this spot while hiking. The sound of that river was so soothing, I felt so at peace surrounded by those rocks. It was like nature was telling me to stop and admire its beauty.
</record>
<record session="session_25" date="10:04 am on 19 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D25:9 D25:10">
Tim: Wow, that sounds amazing. It's true, nature has a way of bringing peace and joy. Anything else like that been happening lately?
John: Things have been going great on the court. We've been putting in a lot of work and achieving our goals, which is awesome.
</record>
<record session="session_25" date="10:04 am on 19 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D25:11 D25:12">
Tim: Hard work pays off, right? What have you and your team been up to lately?
John: We gave it our all during last week's scrimmage. It's amazing to see our team's growth. We know it won't be easy, but it'll be worth it when we see the results.
</record>
<record session="session_25" date="10:04 am on 19 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D25:13 D25:14">
Tim: What areas have you seen the most growth in during your training?
John: Our team has seen the most growth in communication and bonding. It has really helped our performances by allowing us to understand each other's strengths and weaknesses.
</record>
<record session="session_25" date="10:04 am on 19 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D25:15 D25:16">
Tim: Wow, that's awesome! Glad to hear you guys are bonding. Keep it up!
John: Thanks! Let's keep at it and continue supporting each other. Appreciate your assistance!
</record>
<record session="session_25" date="10:04 am on 19 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D25:17">
Tim: Yeah, let's support each other. I'm here for you. Just keep believing in yourself! Bye!
</record>
<record session="session_26" date="3:35 pm on 26 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D26:1 D26:2">
John: Hey Tim! Great to hear from you. My week's been busy - I started doing seminars, helping people with their sports and marketing. It's been awesome!
Tim: Hey John! Sounds awesome! Congrats on how far you've come. How did it go?
</record>
<record session="session_26" date="3:35 pm on 26 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D26:3 D26:4">
John: Thanks! The seminars went really well. All the aspiring profs were so eager and motivated - it was great! I'm really happy I could share my knowledge and help out.
Tim: Wow John! Impressive stuff! I'm starting some big new things too!
</record>
<record session="session_26" date="3:35 pm on 26 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D26:5 D26:6">
John: Thanks! What have you been up to?
Tim: I've been reading cool stories from travelers from around the world. I'm using it to plan my next adventure. This is a book I found with tons of them!
</record>
<record session="session_26" date="3:35 pm on 26 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D26:7 D26:8">
John: Wow, that's cool! Have you read any of the stories? I'm looking for some travel ideas too.
Tim: I read a few of them. One of them is about two hikers who trekked through the Himalayas, sounds awesome!
</record>
<record session="session_26" date="3:35 pm on 26 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D26:9 D26:10">
John: Wow, that sounds awesome! How challenging was the trek through the Himalayas?
Tim: The book mentioned that the trek was tough but worth it, with challenging terrain, altitude sickness, and bad weather. But they made it and saw amazing sights - it really motivated me.
</record>
<record session="session_26" date="3:35 pm on 26 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D26:11 D26:12">
John: Wow! Sounds like a tough journey.
Tim: It's true. Facing challenges can be tough, but it can make us stronger. I just visited a travel agency to see what the requirements would be for my next dream trip.
</record>
<record session="session_26" date="3:35 pm on 26 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D26:13 D26:14">
John: For sure, challenges help us learn and grow. Sounds fun! Keep me updated!
Tim: Thanks, I will. You have to keep pushing for your goals.
</record>
<record session="session_26" date="3:35 pm on 26 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D26:15 D26:16">
John: By the way, who was that main actress in Harry Potter? I've heard about her a lot lately.
Tim: Emma Watson, she's a big supporter of gender equality. I'm a huge fan.
</record>
<record session="session_26" date="3:35 pm on 26 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D26:17 D26:18">
John: Wow, that's great! It's inspiring to see people who use their platform for important causes and make a difference.
Tim: Her women's rights advocacy is also a huge inspiration to me! Seeing people use their platform for causes like gender equality is really inspiring. It's so cool to see people making a difference.
</record>
<record session="session_26" date="3:35 pm on 26 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D26:19 D26:20">
John: Definitely. Making a difference is important to me. I use my influence and resources to help causes I believe in. It's about making the world a better place. Here's a picture of me speaking at a charity event.
Tim: Cool! What causes are you working on? Tell me more about them!
</record>
<record session="session_26" date="3:35 pm on 26 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D26:21 D26:22">
John: I've been working on supporting youth sports and fighting for fair chances in sports for underserved communities. It's important to me that every kid has access to good sports programs. I've been collaborating with organizations to create more opportunities for young athletes and help them succeed. It's amazing to see the difference sports make in people's lives.
Tim: Cool! What have been some memorable experiences working with them?
</record>
<record session="session_26" date="3:35 pm on 26 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D26:23 D26:24">
John: Organizing a basketball camp for kids in my hometown last summer was an awesome experience! Seeing their faces light up when they hit the court was priceless. It was a week full of laughs, high-fives, and personal growth for us all. That opportunity to inspire those kids and show them just how much potential they have was truly incredible.
Tim: Wow! Making a difference to those kids was great! Your passion for helping others is awesome.
</record>
<record session="session_26" date="3:35 pm on 26 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D26:25 D26:26">
John: Thanks! I'm really glad I can make a difference. Have you been doing anything new in your free time?
Tim: In my downtime, I still love to get lost in good books, and this series is one of my favorites. It's a magical world to escape to.
</record>
<record session="session_27" date="5:26 pm on 2 January, 2024" dialogue_ids="D27:1 D27:2">
Tim: Hi John, how's it going? Interesting things have happened since we last talked - I joined a group of globetrotters who are into the same stuff as me. It's been awesome getting to know them and hear about their trips.
John: Hey Tim! Cool to hear about your globetrotting group! Must be great connecting with other traveling buffs. By the way, have you been to Italy? I had a blast there last month.
</record>
<record session="session_27" date="5:26 pm on 2 January, 2024" dialogue_ids="D27:9 D27:10">
Tim: Yeah, knowing another language opens up a lot of opportunities. Have you come across any good resources for learning Spanish? I've been using this app.
John: Yeah! I've been using that app on my phone to practice too! It's helped a lot.
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:24 pm on 7 January, 2024" dialogue_ids="D28:1 D28:2">
Tim: Hey John, long time no talk. On Friday, I got great news - I'm finally in the study abroad program I applied for! Next month, I'm off to Ireland for a semester.
John: Congrats, Tim! That's amazing news. So, where are you going to stay?
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="5:24 pm on 7 January, 2024" dialogue_ids="D28:21">
Tim: No problem. Talk to you soon!
</record>

items.block_b:
<record session="session_7" date="7:54 pm on 17 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:11 D7:12">
John: Having something like this ball to remind me of the bond and support from my teammates is really comforting. It's a nice reminder of why I started playing basketball and my journey. It motivates me to stay strong and give it my all.
Tim: That's so sweet. It's great to have something so meaningful to keep you motivated. I'll keep that in mind next time I need a push to reach my goals.
</record>
<record session="session_7" date="7:54 pm on 17 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:13 D7:14">
John: It's really motivating to have something that reminds you of why you started, and having supportive people around is like having a cheer team that helps you through tough times.
Tim: Yeah, that's true. Having them there to cheer you on can be a powerful source of strength.
</record>
<record session="session_7" date="7:54 pm on 17 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:15 D7:16">
John: Yeah, having that support really encourages me to give it my all and never give up. It's an awesome feeling!
Tim: It's awesome how much strength people can get from each other. Bye!
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="4:29 pm on 21 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:1 D8:2">
John: Hey Tim! Long time no talk. Hope you're doing great. Crazy things have been going on in my life. Just the other day, I found a new gym to stay on my b-ball game. Staying fit is essential to surviving pro ball, so I had to find something that fits the bill. Finding the right spot was tough but here we are!
Tim: Hey John! Really good to hear from you. Staying fit is so important. Must be so cool to practice there. Any issues you had when you got it?
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="4:29 pm on 21 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:3 D8:4">
John: It's been great training here. The gym is awesome, but I had to overcome the hurdle of adapting and tweaking my routine. Finding the right balance was tricky, but I eventually got the hang of it.
Tim: Nice one! It can be tough getting used to a new routine, but once you figure it out, it gets easier. How did you find that balance?
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="4:29 pm on 21 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:5 D8:6">
John: Thanks! Took some trial and error but I figured out a schedule with both basketball stuff and strength training to balance it out. Listening to my body and giving it enough rest made it easier to push myself during practice but also look after me. Here's my workout plan. It helps a lot with staying on track.
Tim: Nice job! Impressive plan you've got there! You've really thought it out. Why include strength training in your routine?
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="4:29 pm on 21 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:7 D8:8">
John: Thanks! Strength training is important for basketball because it builds muscle, increases power, and prevents injuries. It also helps me become more explosive, which is essential in games. Plus, it boosts my athleticism overall.
Tim: That makes sense! Your holistic approach seems to have numerous benefits. Does strength training have a positive impact on your basketball performance?
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="4:29 pm on 21 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:9 D8:10">
John: Definitely! Incorporating strength training really changed the game for me, improving my shooting accuracy, agility, and speed. It gave me the upper hand over my opponents and helped me up my game. It gave me the confidence to take on whatever comes my way.
Tim: Awesome! Gaining confidence on the court must feel great. It's cool how strength training can benefit you. You're doing great in both basketball and fitness, keep it up!
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="4:29 pm on 21 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:11 D8:12">
John: Thanks! Appreciate your support. It's been a journey, but I'm happy with the progress. Excited to see what's next. What about you? How have you been?
Tim: Things have been great since we last talked - I've been focusing on school and reading a bunch of fantasy books. It's a nice way to take a break from all the stress. I've also started learning how to play the piano - it's a learning curve, but it's so satisfying seeing the progress I make! Life's good.
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="4:29 pm on 21 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:13 D8:14">
John: Wow! You're staying busy and having fun. Learning to play this is awesome - it's such a beautiful instrument. Do you have any favorite songs you like playing on it?
Tim: Thanks! I love playing different songs on the piano, but my favorite one to jam to is a theme from a movie I really enjoy. It brings back lots of great memories.
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="4:29 pm on 21 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:15 D8:16">
John: Wow, that's cool! Music really has a way of bringing back memories and evoking emotions, doesn't it? Almost like taking us back in time. Could you tell me more about that film and the memories it brings up for you?
Tim: Yeah, "Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone" is special to me. It was the first movie from the series and brings back some great memories. Watching it with my family was amazing. It was so magical!
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="4:29 pm on 21 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:17 D8:18">
John: Wow, that sounds great, Tim! I love that first movie too, I even have the whole collection! It was so magical! Must've been a dream watching it with your family.
Tim: It was really a dream come true! Watching that movie with my family was awesome, we'd all get comfy with snacks and a blanket and be totally absorbed. Such a special memory!
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="4:29 pm on 21 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:19 D8:20">
John: Cool! Cherish those family moments - they're so irreplaceable. Family time is great! Mine gets together all the time too.
Tim: Family time means a lot to me. This photo is from a special day when we all got together to eat. It was a great day full of love and laughter!
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="4:29 pm on 21 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:21 D8:22">
John: Wow, that looks like such a great day! Do you have any favorite Thanksgiving traditions?
Tim: Thanksgiving's always special for us. We love prepping the feast and talking about what we're thankful for. Plus, watching some movies afterwards - the best!
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="4:29 pm on 21 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:23 D8:24">
John: Thanksgiving dinner with family sounds great! Do you have any favorite movies you watch together?
Tim: During Thanksgiving, we usually watch a few movies. We love "Home Alone" - it always brings lots of laughs!
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="4:29 pm on 21 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:25 D8:26">
John: That's a classic! What other movies do you watch during the holidays?
Tim: We also watch "Elf" during the holidays. It makes us laugh and get us feeling festive!
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="4:29 pm on 21 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:27 D8:28">
John: Those are awesome! Any other holiday movies do you enjoy watching?
Tim: We love "The Santa Clause" too- it's so heartwarming and gets us all feeling festive!
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="4:29 pm on 21 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:29 D8:30">
John: "The Santa Clause" is a classic! It's so sweet and really captures the Christmas magic. It's just one of those movies that gets us all feeling festive. This was our tree last year.
Tim: Yep, it really does. That tree pic looks awesome! It must add so much holiday cheer to your house. This was ours.
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="4:29 pm on 21 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:31 D8:32">
John: That looks awesome! Where did you get this tree?
Tim: I decorated this tree myself, going all out with a Harry Potter theme! It was a blast!
</record>
items.block_c:

John: Wow! Have you been to any places related to it?
Tim: I went to a place in London a few years ago - it was like walking into a Harry Potter movie! I also went on a tour which was amazing. Have you been to any of the real Potter places? I'd love to explore them someday!
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="5:08 pm on 15 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:19">
Tim: Yeah, keep going! Don't give up on your dreams. Talk to you later!
</record>

<record session="session_22" date="9:41 pm on 6 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D22:11 D22:12">

<record session="session_22" date="9:41 pm on 6 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D22:13">

</record>
<record session="session_23" date="4:22 pm on 13 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D23:1 D23:2">

Audrey: Hey! Sounds like you've been busy! I made some goodies recently to thank my neighbors for their pup-friendly homes. It was a nice way to bring some joy around here. Any plans for the weekend?
</record>
<record session="session_23" date="4:22 pm on 13 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D23:3 D23:4">

Audrey: That cafe looks really cozy! Any other spots you would recommend?
</record>
<record session="session_23" date="4:22 pm on 13 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D23:5 D23:6">
Andrew: So this new spot just opened the other day. It's awesome with a sick view and vibe.
Audrey: Wow, looks great! Can I bring my pups with me?
</record>
<record session="session_23" date="4:22 pm on 13 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D23:7 D23:8">
Andrew: Hmmm, not sure if it's suitable for them but hey, there's a great dog park close by! Maybe we can bring our coffee over.
Audrey: Sounds good! Exploring new places is always an adventure for them.
</record>
<record session="session_23" date="4:22 pm on 13 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D23:9 D23:10">
Andrew: Aww, they look so sweet in that sweater! Do they enjoy going to the dog park?
Audrey: The dog park is like paradise for them! They love socializing with the other pups and getting lots of exercise. It's so cute to watch them running around and smelling all the stuff. Do you have any funny stories about your pup at the dog park?
</record>
<record session="session_23" date="4:22 pm on 13 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D23:11 D23:12">
Andrew: There was this one time my pup got too excited and chased a squirrel. He ran around the tree and the squirrel just watched from the branches. It was hilarious!

</record>
<record session="session_23" date="4:22 pm on 13 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D23:13 D23:14">
Andrew: My pup Toby is German Shephard and loves cute sweaters! He's so active. What games do your dogs like to play at the park?

</record>
<record session="session_23" date="4:22 pm on 13 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D23:19 D23:20">

<record session="session_24" date="6:12 pm on 19 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D24:19 D24:20">

<record session="session_26" date="2:36 pm on 28 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D26:9 D26:10">

Andrew: You're doing a great job! They're lucky to have you.
</record>

items.block_b:
<record session="session_4" date="5:41 pm on 3 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:1 D4:2">
Audrey: Hey Andrew! Long time no talk! Last week I finally went on a hike and had this amazing experience with a hummingbird. It was so cool watching it dart around with its wings! Nature is so beautiful.
Andrew: Hey Audrey! Glad to hear from you. That hummingbird was awesome! Nature's the best. Remember I was feeling down because I couldn't get out more? Well, good news - I found a new open space to hike nearby - feels so refreshing!
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="5:41 pm on 3 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:3 D4:4">
Audrey: That looks great! How often are you able to go hiking now?
Andrew: So I usually try to escape the city at least once a weekend - it's my much-needed break!
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="5:41 pm on 3 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:5 D4:6">
Audrey: Nice! I Bet it's great to get away like that.
Andrew: Yep! Nature is so therapeutic for me. It's hard to put into words how great it feels to be surrounded by greenery or standing on top of a mountain breathing in the fresh air. So peaceful and invigorating.


</record>
<record session="session_4" date="5:41 pm on 3 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:7 D4:8">
Audrey: Wow, that view looks great! It really captures that calming and peaceful feeling. It must be really satisfying to capture that tranquility.
Andrew: Yeah! I try to capture those special moments and share that feeling with others.
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="5:41 pm on 3 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:9 D4:10">
Audrey: That's really cool! Spreading that peaceful feeling to others is such a great way to bring happiness and motivation.
Andrew: I agree! It brings me joy to spread that feeling and motivate people to find their own peace - it's like a ripple effect, spreading positivity.
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="5:41 pm on 3 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:11 D4:12">
Audrey: Absolutely. Not only the receiving end feels great, the person spreading it will feel great as well!
Andrew: Yeah, it's crazy how that can bring such great joy and calm to people.
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="5:41 pm on 3 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:13 D4:14">
Audrey: Yeah, by sharing something can make a big difference to others.
Andrew: Yup! We don't realize it, but even the littlest gestures can have a big effect. Spreading good vibes and joy, that's the goal right? So what's up? Anything new or fun going on?
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="5:41 pm on 3 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:15 D4:16">
Audrey: Not much has changed since we last talked. I'm busy taking care of my pets and spending time with them. It's really fulfilling.
Andrew: I bet it's awesome hanging out with them - do your dogs enjoy going on hikes?
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="5:41 pm on 3 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:17 D4:18">
Audrey: My dogs go nuts when we go on hikes! They love exploring new scents and being in nature - it's their happy place. I can tell by their wagging tails and expressions how much they love it. It's so great to see them having so much fun!
Andrew: Wow, that's great! I was wondering if you have any tips or tricks for keeping dogs safe when they're out and about?
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="5:41 pm on 3 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:19 D4:20">
Audrey: Definitely! Safety is super important for me. I even got them something special. They sure look funny, but it works!
Andrew: Awesome to see that you take such good care of your dogs! What else do you do when you walk them?
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="5:41 pm on 3 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:21 D4:22">
Audrey: When I take them out, we usually play fetch with a ball or frisbee. They love chasing it! We also meet other dog owners in the park and have a doggie playdate. It's a great way for me to chat with people and for them to make new friends.
Andrew: Wow, looks like fun! They sure look excited about playing fetch!
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="5:41 pm on 3 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:23 D4:24">
Audrey: They absolutely adore it! They have tons of energy and love meeting new pals at playdates. Plus, they always get excited when I bring those out.
Andrew: Aww, that's so cute! Do they enjoy wearing the party hats? And where did you find their playdates?
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="5:41 pm on 3 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:25 D4:26">
Audrey: The hats don't bother them, they just put them on for fun and treats. And the dog park is great place to start! They can run and mingle with other pooches. It's such a fun spot for playdates!
Andrew: That sounds great! Where is it located?
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="5:41 pm on 3 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:27 D4:28">
Audrey: It's right by the park we usually walk. It's a great spot with lots of trees and benches for us to watch the dogs play.
Andrew: That's awesome, not too far away then! I'll have to check it out. Thanks for the suggestion!
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="5:41 pm on 3 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:29 D4:30">
Audrey: Yup! Not at all! Let me know how it goes.
Andrew: Sure, I'll let you know. Always great chatting with you! Ttyl.
</record>
<record session="session_5" date="10:47 am on 6 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D5:1 D5:2">
Andrew: Hey! Since we last spoke, I've been looking for a doggo to adopt - browsing websites, visiting shelters and asking friends of theirs. It's been both fun and annoying!
Audrey: Sounds like a fun and demanding task! Getting to meet new pups must bring so much happiness. What  do you think you can do to make the process smoother?
</record>
<record session="session_5" date="10:47 am on 6 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D5:3 D5:4">
Andrew: Meeting all these adorable pups has been awesome! For those considering getting a pup, the size of living space and the exercise needs of the breed are important. For me, a person living in an apartment, a smaller dog would be best, but if one is active, consider getting one that loves to play and run.
Audrey: That's some good advice! It's important to consider the space and energy needs of a dog.
</record>
<record session="session_5" date="10:47 am on 6 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D5:5 D5:6">
Andrew: Yeah! Finding a pet-friendly place to live has been tough too. I'm contacting landlords and checking out neighborhoods to find the perfect spot.
Audrey: Guessing it's tough to find housing. Any particular part of town you want to live in?
</record>
<record session="session_5" date="10:47 am on 6 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D5:7 D5:8">
Andrew: I'm looking for a place near a park or woods, so I can stay close to nature and give the dog a large open space to run around
Audrey: That's a good plan! I'm lucky to have a park near me - it's great for my pup's walks. Last Friday we took a road trip - we went to a beautiful national park and my dogs had a blast! It was an awesome trip!
</record>
<record session="session_5" date="10:47 am on 6 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D5:9 D5:10">
Andrew: Nice! Glad the pups had a great road trip. Do you take them on road trips often?
Audrey: I take them on road trips once every couple of months. It's a great way for them to explore and stay active.
</record>
<record session="session_5" date="10:47 am on 6 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D5:11 D5:12">
Andrew: Wow, that's awesome! I really wish I could go on a road trip with a furry companion.
Audrey: It's a cool experience. Having your furry friends on a road trip is an amazing experience. They make it really fun and exciting. It's definitely something to look forward to!
</record>
<record session="session_5" date="10:47 am on 6 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D5:13 D5:14">
Andrew: Adding that to my bucket list! Can't wait for the day I actually go on a trip with my dog!
Audrey: Good luck with your search! Fingers crossed you find the perfect one.
</record>

<record session="session_9" date="1:51 pm on 26 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D9:5 D9:6">

<record session="session_9" date="1:51 pm on 26 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D9:9 D9:10">

<record session="session_9" date="1:51 pm on 26 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D9:15 D9:16">

<record session="session_10" date="8:32 pm on 3 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D10:5 D10:6">

<record session="session_11" date="9:48 am on 8 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D11:5 D11:6">

<record session="session_11" date="9:48 am on 8 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D11:19 D11:20">

<record session="session_14" date="11:05 am on 4 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:1 D14:2">

<record session="session_19" date="5:53 pm on 24 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D19:25 D19:26">

<record session="session_13" date="3:52 pm on 27 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D13:1 D13:2">
Andrew: Hey Audrey! How are you? My GF and I just had a great experience volunteering at a pet shelter on Monday - it was so rewarding! We loved spending time with those cute animals and it gave us so much joy. It was so rewarding, it reminded me just how much I love them!
Audrey: Hi Andrew! I'm good, thanks. That's awesome about the pet shelter volunteering. Helping animals really is great and you can tell when they're happy! So happy for you getting to experience that! I should do that someday too!
</record>
<record session="session_13" date="3:52 pm on 27 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D13:3 D13:4">
Andrew: Thanks! Seeing them so content makes me happy, it really makes me realize how special and full of love they are! Have you ever volunteered at an animal shelter? It can be so rewarding. 
Audrey: Never been to an animal shelter before, but it must be great! My four fur babies are more important to me than anything! Here's a pic of us from a fun day out at the park.
</record>
<record session="session_13" date="3:52 pm on 27 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D13:5 D13:6">
Andrew: Aww that's a cute photo! How are their personalities? Tell me more!
Audrey: Well the oldest one is the most relaxed, like a wise old sage. The second one is always ready for a game. The third one can be naughty but loves a good cuddle. And the youngest one is full of life and always up for an adventure. They all have their own individual personalities and I adore them.
</record>
<record session="session_13" date="3:52 pm on 27 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D13:7 D13:8">
Andrew: Wow, they sound amazing! They must remind you of your childhood pup. That photo of you with your dog is so cute, he looks like the most playful one ever! Pets really do bring so much joy in your life!
Audrey: Thanks! That one is Max, my childhood dog. He had lots of energy and loved a game of fetch. I have lots of great memories with him. Pets sure bring a lot of joy.
</record>
<record session="session_13" date="3:52 pm on 27 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D13:9 D13:10">
Andrew: Yeah! Their love and energy can really brighten up a day. It's amazing how close we can get to them and the memories they create for us. Do you have any other special memories with Max that you remember fondly?
Audrey: Max and I would take long walks in the neighborhood when I was a kid. We explored new paths, him sniffing and marking his territory. We grew really close, and I shared my worries and hopes with him. He was a great listener, always there for me. Those days are some of my favorite memories. 
</record>
<record session="session_13" date="3:52 pm on 27 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D13:11 D13:12">
Andrew: Pets are more than just pets - they become friends and confidantes. They always know how to listen and provide comfort when we need it. They can make us feel so loved and understood, leaving a lasting mark on our lives.
Audrey: Pets truly make our lives so much better. They listen without judging and give us the best unconditional love. They always leave a mark in our hearts and remind us how it feels to be seen and understood. I'm thankful to have them around - they bring so much joy, comfort, and love.
</record>
<record session="session_13" date="3:52 pm on 27 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D13:13 D13:14">
Andrew: You nailed it! That's why we went volunteering with animals. It has been one of the most rewarding things I've ever done. They really do lift our spirits with all their love, joy, and comfort.
Audrey: I'm so glad you guys got to experience that! Animals really have a way of brightening our day and giving us lots of love and joy. I'm sure the pet shelter really appreciated your help too!
</record>
<record session="session_13" date="3:52 pm on 27 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D13:15 D13:16">
Andrew: Yeah we had a blast volunteering. It's our way of giving back and making their lives better!
Audrey: I'm sure your kindness and care will make them happier no doubt!
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="11:05 am on 4 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:1 D14:2">
Andrew: Hey, Audrey! I can't wait for the weekend. My girlfriend, Toby and I are going camping. It's been forever since I've been in nature.
Audrey: That's awesome! That must be fun! I just started agility classes with my pups at a dog park. It's awesome to watch them learn and build relationships with other dogs. Seeing them face and conquer challenges really warms my heart.
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="11:05 am on 4 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:3 D14:4">

Audrey: Thanks! They've come a long way. They have so much fun with it, it's a great physical and mental workout. I take them to the park twice a week for practice - it's been a great bonding experience.
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="11:05 am on 4 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:5 D14:6">
Andrew: Awesome! You're having fun with them and keeping them busy - how's that going? Btw look at the trail that I was just at. Cool right?
Audrey: It's been tough at times, but overall it's going great. We're all growing together. Check out this pic of us on a trail hike!
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="11:05 am on 4 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:7 D14:8">
Andrew: Wow, nice hike! How long was the trail?
Audrey: The hike took us two hours and it was stunning! We saw lots of amazing views and it was great to explore nature.
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="11:05 am on 4 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:9 D14:10">
Andrew: That sounds awesome! Being able to just be in nature and appreciate it is really cool. I wish I could do that more often.
Audrey: Nature really refreshes you, right? It's nice to appreciate all the beauty around us. Are there any outdoor activities you enjoy lately?
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="11:05 am on 4 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:11 D14:12">
Andrew: Well for me hiking is the best. Being out in nature with all the trees and fresh air always refreshes me. Reaching the top of a challenging trail is amazing too - it feels like all worries just vanish when you get to the top.
Audrey: Yeah, totally. It's like you've achieved something and all worries just fade away. Nature is pretty special, huh?
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="11:05 am on 4 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:13 D14:14">
Andrew: Yeah, nature really calms me down and relaxes my mind. It's like a break from the craziness of city living.
Audrey: Yeah! It's a refuge from the busy city life and it's even better when you can share it with someone special. My pets have been my good ol' buddies during all the tough times! They make me so happy and I love them so much.
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="11:05 am on 4 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:15 D14:16">
Andrew: Agreed! Sharing something you enjoy with someone is great. Plus, those types of bonds bring loads of joy and love.
Audrey: Yeah, humans and animals have a cool connection. They bring us so much joy and love. I'm blessed to have my furry friends in my life. They're my companions and always make my day better.
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="11:05 am on 4 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:17 D14:18">
Andrew: They're pretty lucky to have you as their owner. Hoping for the day I can have such a deep bond with Toby and experience that special bond too.
Audrey: Yeah they really mean the world to me. Btw, I never really asked, what breed is Toby?
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="11:05 am on 4 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:19 D14:20">
Andrew: He's a German Shepherd - they're so smart and loyal! What do you think?
Audrey: German Shepherds are indeed awesome! They are super loyal and smart. You'll have an amazing connection with one!
</record>

<record session="session_17" date="12:24 am on 24 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D17:19 D17:20">

</record>
<record session="session_17" date="12:24 am on 24 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D17:21">
Andrew: Yep, Toby and I are gonna have a blast exploring outdoors! Can't wait.
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="7:49 pm on 6 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D18:1 D18:2">
Andrew: Hey Audrey, how's it going? Since we last talked, a few new things have come up in my life. Work's been tough and stressful, so my outdoor activities have taken a backseat. Finding balance has been challenging.
Audrey: Hey Andrew, good to hear from you. Sorry to hear about work being tough. Finding that balance can be challenging, huh? It can feel like there's not enough time. Just remember to take care of yourself and find ways to manage stress. Hang in there!
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="7:49 pm on 6 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D18:3 D18:4">
Andrew: Thanks! It's tough, but I guess that's just part of life, huh? How do you make sure you have enough time for yourself?
Audrey: Yeah, it's tough to find time for yourself. I make sure to do at least one self-care activity each day - like treating myself to something nice. Don't forget to take care of yourself and have some fun too!
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="7:49 pm on 6 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D18:5 D18:6">
Andrew: Yeah, self-care is really important isn't it. I've been adding simple things to my day like grabbing a coffee in the morning or going for a walk at lunch. It kinda helps me recharge and chill out a little.
Audrey: That's great! Glad you found ways to relax. It's nice to have those little moments of joy. Something cool recently happened with my furry friends - I organized a doggy playdate with the neighbors' dogs. Seeing all those tails wagging was so sweet. They must have had so much fun!
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="7:49 pm on 6 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D18:7 D18:8">
Andrew: That's awesome. I bet they all had a blast! Got any pics from that day?
Audrey: Here's a pic from the playdate. It was great seeing them having fun together. Their joy was infectious and made my heart feel so full.
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="7:49 pm on 6 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D18:9 D18:10">
Andrew: That's so heartwarming! Seeing them enjoy themselves like that is always a joy. :)
Audrey: I'm so happy seeing them have a great time. Last week I even got some new beds for them, just to give them some extra comfort now the weather's cooling down and they were happy! It's incredible how such a simple thing can bring them so much happiness.
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="7:49 pm on 6 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D18:11 D18:12">
Andrew: Animals can really find joy in the simple things. That was so nice of you. Do you have any pictures of the new beds?
Audrey: Sure! Here's a pic of them. Super cozy and comfy. My furry friends love them!
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="7:49 pm on 6 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D18:13 D18:14">
Andrew: Do they enjoy snoozing on it? It looks really comfy!
Audrey: They absolutely love it! They curl up and snuggle like they're in a cloud - it's adorable!
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="7:49 pm on 6 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D18:15 D18:16">
Andrew: That's really cute! Animals really know how to be happy with the simple stuff. Last weekend I got away for a hike and it was such a relief to get away from the city. Here's a photo of the beautiful sunset I witnessed during my hike.
Audrey: Nice escape! Glad you got out hiking. Are you planning to hike with Toby someday?
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="7:49 pm on 6 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D18:17 D18:18">

Audrey: Did you find a dog-friendly place to live yet? I remember you mentioning it.
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="7:49 pm on 6 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D18:19 D18:20">
