Audrey: Keep going, you'll find a great place to live for your pet soon!
</record>
<record session="session_18" date="7:49 pm on 6 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D18:21 D18:22">
Andrew: Thanks! I appreciate the help. I'll keep searching for that perfect place for dogs!
Audrey: No worries! You got this. Don't give up. Take care!
</record>
<record session="session_19" date="5:53 pm on 24 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D19:1 D19:2">
Andrew: Hey Audrey! Long time no talk! How have you been?
Audrey: Hey! I'm alright. Had some bumps though - last Friday at the park one of my pups saw something and pulled so hard the leash busted. Scared that she might run off and get hurt, so I had to chase after her. Luckily I caught her before anything bad happened. Little moments like this remind me how important she is and how we should be careful when we're out there.
</record>
<record session="session_19" date="5:53 pm on 24 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D19:3 D19:4">
Andrew: Oh man, sorry to hear that! I'm totally getting anxious just thinking about my dog getting lost. Precious must have been really scared. What did you do to calm her down?
Audrey: I petted and hugged her, spoke calmly, and slowly walked her to relax. Our bond feels even stronger when moments like these show up.
</record>
<record session="session_19" date="5:53 pm on 24 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D19:5 D19:6">
Andrew: She looks so adorable! That's the connection I'd like to have with Toby. Any advice on creating a strong relationship with dogs?
Audrey: Building trust with them needs patience and regular training. Give them time and love, and praise their successes.
</record>
<record session="session_19" date="5:53 pm on 24 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D19:7 D19:8">
Andrew: Thanks for the tips! Patience and practice are important for establishing a bond with our pooches, just like any other meaningful relationship. I guess some dogs just need more time! It must be so satisfying to see those successes and progress. Oh, and your pup looks so sharp in that green hat! Is there anything specific you do with them to work on training?
Audrey: Thanks! We work on obedience and teach them tricks like sit, stay, shake, and roll over. It's fun and rewarding for both of us.
</record>
<record session="session_19" date="5:53 pm on 24 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D19:9 D19:10">
Andrew: Wow, teaching them tricks must be super fun! How often do you take them for walks?
Audrey: Very often, multiple times a day even, it's a great exercise for them and great bonding time for us.
</record>
<record session="session_21" date="4:18 pm on 4 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D21:1 D21:2">
Andrew: Hi Audrey! Been a while since I hear from you. How's it been?
Audrey: Hey Andrew! It's been a wild ride! I did something fun with my pups over the weekend, took them to the beach and it was so fun to see them playing in the ocean.
</record>
<record session="session_26" date="2:36 pm on 28 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D26:1 D26:2">
Audrey: Hey Andrew, I wanted to let you know about something going on with my dogs. I noticed they weren't acting normally, so I made an appointment with an animal behaviorist last Wed. It's been a bit hectic but I'm hopeful it'll help me better understand them.
Andrew: Oh no! Sorry to hear that your dogs haven't been themselves. Are they doing ok? How did the appointment with the animal behaviorist go? Did you receive any helpful advice or insights?
</record>
<record session="session_26" date="2:36 pm on 28 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D26:11 D26:12">
Audrey: Thanks! They're really special to me and I want the best for them. Here's a pic of them having a blast last summer, so happy! I'm looking forward the day they are back to normal.
Andrew: Aww, they're having such a blast! What kind are they? I'm wishing you and your pups the best. 
</record>
<record session="session_26" date="2:36 pm on 28 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D26:25 D26:26">
Audrey: Let's check out the trail first. It's a peaceful spot to bring the fur babies for the day.
Andrew: Sounds great! There's a lake near the trail too! It's gonna be awesome!
</record>
<record session="session_26" date="2:36 pm on 28 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D26:27 D26:28">
Audrey: Oh nice! Can't wait to explore it and hang out with our furry friends. Should be a peaceful day! Here's a photo of the lake I found online.
Andrew: Wow, that looks awesome! Do you think the dogs will like it? Which trail do you have in mind?
</record>
<record session="session_27" date="7:59 pm on 4 November, 2023" dialogue_ids="D27:1 D27:2">
Andrew: Hey Audrey, had a great weekend! My girlfriend and I went on a bike ride and stumbled upon a cool park outside of town. It was awesome to get away from the city and be surrounded by nature.
Audrey: That's cool! I love checking out new parks with my four pups. Last weekend was so fun - our dogs were able to run around and get some fresh air. On top of that, I recently joined a dog owners group to learn how to better take care of them.
</record>
<record session="session_27" date="7:59 pm on 4 November, 2023" dialogue_ids="D27:7 D27:8">
Andrew: Thanks, I think that's what I need to hear. I'll take good care of my dogs first.
Audrey: That's great! Let me know if you need any help, I'm here for you! See how happy they are? You don't need more dogs to make them happy! :)
</record>
<record session="session_28" date="9:02 am on 22 November, 2023" dialogue_ids="D28:1 D28:2">
Audrey: Hey Andrew! Long time no talk! Last Friday I took my fur kids to the pet salon - they were so psyched and their tails were wagging like crazy! It took a while for them to calm down, but all cut up they looked so cute!

<record session="session_23" date="9:23 pm on 4 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D23:19 D23:20">

<record session="session_23" date="9:23 pm on 4 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D23:21">

</record>
<record session="session_24" date="6:02 pm on 18 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D24:3 D24:4">

</record>
<record session="session_24" date="6:02 pm on 18 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D24:5 D24:6">

</record>
<record session="session_24" date="6:02 pm on 18 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D24:7 D24:8">

</record>
<record session="session_24" date="6:02 pm on 18 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D24:9 D24:10">

</record>
<record session="session_24" date="6:02 pm on 18 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D24:11 D24:12">

</record>
<record session="session_24" date="6:02 pm on 18 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D24:13 D24:14">

</record>
<record session="session_24" date="6:02 pm on 18 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D24:15 D24:16">

</record>
<record session="session_24" date="6:02 pm on 18 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D24:17 D24:18">

<record session="session_24" date="6:02 pm on 18 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D24:19 D24:20">

</record>
<record session="session_24" date="6:02 pm on 18 September, 2022" dialogue_ids="D24:21">
John: I'll keep my fingers crossed for you! You will definitely succeed, I look forward to the details!
</record>

We combined programming and gaming, and created this virtual world inspired by Witcher 3. It was awesome to see our ideas come to life!

<record session="session_6" date="9:32 pm on 20 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D6:3 D6:4">

James: It was quite the experience. Unfortunately, I don't have a screenshot of the full virtual world, but I do have a screenshot of the game character I created. It was a lot of work but so rewarding when it all came together. Super satisfying!
</record>
<record session="session_6" date="9:32 pm on 20 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D6:5 D6:6">
John: Wow, James! This is amazing. I can really feel the atmosphere here. Did you get the inspiration for this from something?
James: Thanks, I'm glad you can feel the atmosphere. I got the idea from a walk with my dogs two weeks ago. We were walking around our neighborhood, and a stranger was walking towards us. I had never seen her nearby before. Her eyes and appearance amazed me so much, it seemed to me that I fell in love at first sight. It’s a pity that I didn’t approach her to get to know her, but at least I remembered her appearance and embodied it in the game.
</record>
<record session="session_6" date="9:32 pm on 20 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D6:7 D6:8">
John: That's awesome. Real-life experiences can be so inspiring. It's like the virtual world is connected to the real world. By the way, two days ago I wanted to be alone with nature. This is the canyon I found in the surrounding area. Very calming view.
James: That's so cool you had a similar experience. I bet you felt inspired seeing it in person.
</record>
<record session="session_6" date="9:32 pm on 20 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D6:9 D6:10">
John: Capturing that view was amazing. It was like connecting the real and the imaginary. It really sparked my creativity and motivation.
James: Cool! What else gives you motivation?
</record>
<record session="session_6" date="9:32 pm on 20 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D6:11 D6:12">
John: I adhere to the principle that only those who rest well work well. Therefore, chilling with friends and traveling always give me motivation to work further.
James: I agree with you, I also love to travel. Last year I visited Italy, for example. A very beautiful country with delicious food.
</record>
<record session="session_6" date="9:32 pm on 20 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D6:13 D6:14">

</record>
<record session="session_6" date="9:32 pm on 20 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D6:15 D6:16">

James: It would be cool to go somewhere together next year, don't you think?
</record>
<record session="session_6" date="9:32 pm on 20 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D6:17 D6:18">

</record>
<record session="session_7" date="11:04 am on 23 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D7:3 D7:4">

</record>
<record session="session_7" date="11:04 am on 23 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D7:5 D7:6">

James: I picked that spot because it had great views and lots of trails. It was perfect for them to explore nature and have fun. Plus, there's nothing like being surrounded by lush greenery and clean air.
</record>
<record session="session_7" date="11:04 am on 23 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D7:7 D7:8">
John: Agreed! It is a great way to escape the everyday. Wish I could spend more time in nature!
James: Love hearing the crunch of leaves under my feet and the peacefulness. It helps me clear my head and chill.
</record>
<record session="session_7" date="11:04 am on 23 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D7:9 D7:10">
John: I need some chill vibes too because it's been crazy for me lately.
James: What's been going on? Is there anything you want to talk about? I'm here for you.
</record>
<record session="session_7" date="11:04 am on 23 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D7:11 D7:12">

</record>
<record session="session_7" date="11:04 am on 23 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D7:13 D7:14">

</record>
<record session="session_7" date="11:04 am on 23 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D7:15 D7:16">

James: Gotcha, what's the problem with the project? Need a hand figuring out some ideas?
</record>
<record session="session_7" date="11:04 am on 23 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D7:17 D7:18">

James: Not sure about your algorithm, but breaking it down into smaller steps might help. Doing some research on similar algorithms or asking other programmers for advice could be beneficial. Don't be afraid to seek help and remember, every problem has a solution.
</record>

</record>
<record session="session_6" date="9:32 pm on 20 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D6:5 D6:6">

I had never seen her nearby before. Her eyes and appearance amazed me so much, it seemed to me that I fell in love at first sight. It’s a pity that I didn’t approach her to get to know her, but at least I remembered her appearance and embodied it in the game.
</record>
<record session="session_6" date="9:32 pm on 20 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D6:7 D6:8">

</record>
<record session="session_6" date="9:32 pm on 20 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D6:9 D6:10">

</record>
<record session="session_6" date="9:32 pm on 20 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D6:11 D6:12">

</record>
<record session="session_6" date="9:32 pm on 20 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D6:13 D6:14">

</record>
<record session="session_6" date="9:32 pm on 20 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D6:15 D6:16">

</record>
<record session="session_6" date="9:32 pm on 20 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D6:17 D6:18">

<record session="session_6" date="9:32 pm on 20 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D6:19">

<record session="session_7" date="11:04 am on 23 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D7:1 D7:2">

</record>
<record session="session_7" date="11:04 am on 23 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D7:3 D7:4">

<record session="session_7" date="11:04 am on 23 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D7:5 D7:6">

</record>
<record session="session_7" date="11:04 am on 23 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D7:7 D7:8">

James: Love hearing the crunch of leaves under my feet and the peacefulness. It helps me clear my head and chill.
</record>
<record session="session_7" date="11:04 am on 23 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D7:9 D7:10">

<record session="session_7" date="11:04 am on 23 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D7:11 D7:12">

</record>
<record session="session_7" date="11:04 am on 23 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D7:15 D7:16">

<record session="session_7" date="11:04 am on 23 April, 2022" dialogue_ids="D7:17 D7:18">

</record>

</record>
<record session="session_10" date="12:45 am on 8 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D10:5 D10:6">

John: Definitely worth it! It took some planning and coordination, but seeing everyone come together for a good cause was so rewarding.
</record>
<record session="session_10" date="12:45 am on 8 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D10:7 D10:8">

John: Yeah, for sure! It was awesome and I want to do more events like that. It combines my interests and helps the community. Plus, it's great to get people together for some friendly competition.
</record>
<record session="session_10" date="12:45 am on 8 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D10:9 D10:10">
James: Combining gaming and volunteering is a great idea! So fun and fulfilling. Where did you send the collected money?
John: Our main goal was to raise money for a dog shelter, which is not far from the street where I live. And we did it!
</record>
<record session="session_10" date="12:45 am on 8 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D10:11 D10:12">
James: Helping animals is really important!
John: I agree. We still had some money left after helping the shelter, and we decided to use this money to buy groceries and cook some food for the homeless. They were very happy about it.
</record>
<record session="session_10" date="12:45 am on 8 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D10:13 D10:14">
James: Glad you are helping those in need! You are doing a great job John, keep up the good work!
John: Thanks for your support, James! I won't stop there, I will do more and more good things!
</record>
<record session="session_10" date="12:45 am on 8 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D10:15">
James: I'm really proud of you!
</record>
<record session="session_11" date="5:00 pm on 11 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D11:1 D11:2">
John: Hey James, it's been a bit since we last talked. Something cool happened recently - I volunteered my programming skills for a social cause. It was cool to use my passion to do something good. I made a software tool for one charitable foundation which helped streamline their operations and make them run more smoothly. Seeing my skills making a real difference in the world was really rewarding.
James: Hey John! Glad to hear from you. It's awesome that you used your skills to make a difference. Bet it was cool to see it in action. Would love to hear more about it!
</record>
<record session="session_11" date="5:00 pm on 11 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D11:3 D11:4">
John: Previously, this foundation used paper records and all inventory was recorded manually. I made an application that structured their work, and now everything they need for inventory is in one application on their smartphone.
James: Wow John, that's awesome! Must feel great to be part of something so important. I would love to see any visual examples of the impact your software made.
</record>
<record session="session_11" date="5:00 pm on 11 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D11:5 D11:6">
John: Yeah, here's a screenshot of the system. It'll make tracking inventory, resources, and donations run smoother and generate reports for analysis. Feels great knowing my skills are making a real difference to them.
James: Wow John, that's awesome! What motivated you to create such an amazing system for them?
</record>
<record session="session_11" date="5:00 pm on 11 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D11:7 D11:8">
John: I was inspired by their passion for helping kids, so I wanted to contribute in any way I could. Plus, coding lets me challenge myself and expand my skills, so this was a great chance to do both. It's really rewarding to use my coding skills to make a difference.
James: That's really great, John! It's awesome how you blended your passion with a good cause. How did it affect you?
</record>
<record session="session_11" date="5:00 pm on 11 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D11:9 D11:10">
John: It showed me the power of tech to make positive changes, beyond just my own enjoyment. It gave me a real sense of purpose.
James: Discovering our passions is truly rewarding. How do you think this experience will impact your future plans?
</record>
<record session="session_11" date="5:00 pm on 11 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D11:11 D11:12">
John: This experience has given me a clearer sense of purpose and motivated me to use my programming skills to make a positive impact. I'm now considering volunteer roles and potentially a career in the non-profit sector.
James: That's really inspiring. Have you found any non-profit organizations that align with your values and passion for programming?
</record>
<record session="session_11" date="5:00 pm on 11 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D11:13 D11:14">
John: I haven’t found it yet, but to be honest I haven’t looked for it. I think it won’t be difficult for me to find the organization I need.
James: There are lots of places where you can show off your skills! I'm sure you'll find one that's perfect for you in making a difference.
</record>
<record session="session_11" date="5:00 pm on 11 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D11:15 D11:16">
John: I'll be happy to find a place where my skills and passions are a perfect match. I'm hoping to make a positive impact there.
James: I'm sure you'll find the right spot, John. Your skills and passions will be a great addition. Good luck!
</record>
<record session="session_11" date="5:00 pm on 11 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D11:17 D11:18">
John: Thanks, your encouragement means a lot.
James: I'm here for you. Good luck!
</record>
<record session="session_11" date="5:00 pm on 11 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D11:19">
John: Thanks, James! Appreciate it. Take care and talk soon!
</record>
<record session="session_12" date="7:33 pm on 23 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D12:1 D12:2">
James: Hey John, last weekend I had an awesome time at the amusement park with my friends. It was a great break from the virtual world. I went on some awesome roller coasters and it reminded me of when I was a kid. Everything was so real and exciting; it felt like I was in a video game!
John: Hey James! Sounds like an awesome time! I bet those rides brought back some great memories. Were there any other attractions besides the roller coaster?
</record>
<record session="session_12" date="7:33 pm on 23 May, 2022" dialogue_ids="D12:3 D12:4">
James: Of course, I also managed to ride the Ferris wheel, electric cars and buggies. What's new with you?
John: That's really cool! Last Friday I entered a local tournament and took second place! It was a wild experience and the competitive energy was insane.
</record>

<record session="session_16" date="9:26 am on 1 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D16:3 D16:4">
Deborah: Jolene, sorry to hear that. It must be really tough. I'm here for you and if I can do anything, just let me know. Is there anything that's helping you cope?

</record>
<record session="session_16" date="9:26 am on 1 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D16:7 D16:8">

Jolene: Thanks Deborah. Having her around shows me I can stay strong and find joy in the small stuff.
</record>
<record session="session_16" date="9:26 am on 1 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D16:9 D16:10">
Deborah: Enjoying the little things is key. Those little moments can give us a boost and push us forward. How have you been taking care of yourself lately?
Jolene: I'm trying to prioritize self-care, like yoga and meditation. It helps me stay balanced and grounded.
</record>
<record session="session_16" date="9:26 am on 1 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D16:11 D16:12">
Deborah:  If you're interested, I can suggest some routines for you to try.
Jolene:  I'm always on the lookout for new routines to mix things up.
</record>
<record session="session_16" date="9:26 am on 1 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D16:13 D16:14">

Jolene: This room looks perfect for it. Do you have any favorite routines you can share?
</record>
<record session="session_16" date="9:26 am on 1 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D16:15 D16:16">

</record>
<record session="session_16" date="9:26 am on 1 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D16:17 D16:18">
Deborah: It's a great way to find balance in tough times. Try it out and let me know what you think!

</record>
<record session="session_16" date="9:26 am on 1 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D16:19 D16:20">

</record>
<record session="session_17" date="8:50 pm on 12 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D17:1 D17:2">

</record>
<record session="session_17" date="8:50 pm on 12 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D17:3 D17:4">

Jolene:  Appreciate your support! BTW, I wanted to share this with you.
</record>
<record session="session_17" date="8:50 pm on 12 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D17:5 D17:6">

</record>
<record session="session_17" date="8:50 pm on 12 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D17:7 D17:8">

</record>

</record>
<record session="session_17" date="8:50 pm on 12 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D17:11 D17:12">

</record>

<record session="session_4" date="9:48 am on 4 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:7 D4:8">

<record session="session_4" date="9:48 am on 4 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:9 D4:10">

</record>
<record session="session_4" date="9:48 am on 4 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:11 D4:12">

<record session="session_6" date="4:12 pm on 22 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D6:1 D6:2">

</record>
<record session="session_6" date="4:12 pm on 22 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D6:9 D6:10">

<record session="session_6" date="4:12 pm on 22 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D6:11 D6:12">

<record session="session_6" date="4:12 pm on 22 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D6:13 D6:14">

<record session="session_7" date="4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:1 D7:2">

Deborah: Hey Jolene! Great to hear from you. Taking a break is key. How have those practices been helping with everything?
</record>
<record session="session_7" date="4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:3 D7:4">

Deborah: Wow, cool that yoga has been helping you out! Do they also do yoga with you? Does your partner do yoga with you?
</record>
<record session="session_7" date="4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:5 D7:6">

Deborah: Aw, that's wonderful! How long have you been married?
</record>
<record session="session_7" date="4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:7 D7:8">

Deborah: Sounds nice, Jolene. Enjoying the journey is the main thing. So, how did you two meet?
</record>
<record session="session_7" date="4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:9 D7:10">

</record>
<record session="session_7" date="4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:11 D7:12">

Deborah: Have yoga or meditation helped with any stress?
</record>

<record session="session_9" date="11:22 am on 13 March, 2023" dialogue_ids="D9:7 D9:8">

</record>
<record session="session_12" date="4:30 pm on 9 April, 2023" dialogue_ids="D12:3 D12:4">
Deborah: My mom was interested in art. She believed art could give out strong emotions and uniquely connect us. When I go to an art show, it's like we're still experiencing it together even though she's gone. It's hard but comforting.
Jolene: Losing someone is hard, but finding something that helps you cope is great.
</record>
<record session="session_12" date="4:30 pm on 9 April, 2023" dialogue_ids="D12:5 D12:6">
Deborah: Finding ways to keep her memory alive gives me peace. It's amazing how something simple like artwork can bring back powerful emotions and remind us of those we've lost. It's about finding solace in the things we love, and art has done that for me.
Jolene: Even though my snakes can't chat or understand what I'm going through, our time together is valuable and teaches me to take time and be in tune with myself. Similarly, playing video games with my partner after a long day is a great way for me to relax.
</record>
<record session="session_12" date="4:30 pm on 9 April, 2023" dialogue_ids="D12:7 D12:8">

</record>
<record session="session_15" date="7:37 pm on 9 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D15:21 D15:22">

</record>
<record session="session_16" date="9:26 am on 1 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D16:3 D16:4">

</record>

<record session="session_28" date="3:09 pm on 15 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D28:1 D28:2">

</record>
<record session="session_28" date="3:09 pm on 15 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D28:3 D28:4">

<record session="session_28" date="3:09 pm on 15 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D28:5 D28:6">

<record session="session_4" date="9:48 am on 4 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:31 D4:32">

I like to come to this spot by the water near my mom's old house. It's where I reflect on her life and find some peace. Being surrounded by nature helps a lot.

<record session="session_4" date="9:48 am on 4 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:13 D4:14">

<record session="session_4" date="9:48 am on 4 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:17 D4:18">

You'll feel a stretch in your back and shoulders as you hold it for a few breaths, then switch sides. It's great for relaxing tense muscles.

<record session="session_4" date="9:48 am on 4 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:19 D4:20">

<record session="session_4" date="9:48 am on 4 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:21 D4:22">

<record session="session_4" date="9:48 am on 4 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:23 D4:24">

<record session="session_4" date="9:48 am on 4 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:25 D4:26">

</record>
<record session="session_4" date="9:48 am on 4 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:27 D4:28">
Jolene: Wow, Deb! That's beautiful! Can you tell me the backstory of that bouquet?
Deborah: My friend gave me this bouquet when I was struggling, and it gives me hope and courage. I'm filled with warmth and appreciation when I look at it.
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="9:48 am on 4 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:29 D4:30">
Jolene: That's really sweet. Such a small thing can make a real difference.
Deborah: It's amazing how something as simple as flowers can make a real difference. Nature sure is beautiful.
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="9:48 am on 4 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:31 D4:32">
Jolene: Where are some of your favorite nature spots?
Deborah: Oh, there's so many great places! My favorite is a park with a forest trail - it's so calming getting lost in nature. Then there's this beach nearby that I love - the sound of the waves and the sand under my feet make me feel all peaceful and happy. Do you have any favorite spots, Jolene?
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="9:48 am on 4 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:33 D4:34">
Jolene: Here's a picture I took on vacation last summer in Bogota. It was so beautiful and calming watching the sunset over the water. It definitely made me appreciate nature's calming power.
Deborah: That sounds great, Jolene. Nature's calming for sure. Guess it helps us forget the daily craziness and find inner peace. No wonder you're a fan! I like to come to this spot by the water near my mom's old house. It's where I reflect on her life and find some peace. Being surrounded by nature helps a lot.
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="9:48 am on 4 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:35 D4:36">
Jolene: That's so touching! Do you have any little traditions that you do when you come to reflect on your mom?
Deborah: Do you remember this amulet from her? Whenever I come here, I bring it with me. It's how I feel her love and stay close to her. Holding it brings me comfort.
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="9:48 am on 4 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:37 D4:38">
Jolene: It's amazing how something so small can have such a big impact, huh?
Deborah: Yeah, even small things like this can make a big difference. It's a reminder of all the love and strength we have inside, connecting us to people we've lost and comforting us.
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="9:48 am on 4 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:39 D4:40">
Jolene: It can keep them close in our hearts every day.
Deborah: Anna also has a pendant that she wears in memory of her mother! This also brought us closer.
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="9:48 am on 4 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:41 D4:42">
Jolene: It's nice to have those reminders as a source of strength when we need it.
Deborah: Life's tough but hang in there. Look to your sources of strength and you'll do great. Stay in touch, take care of yourself, and know I'm always here to cheer you on!
</record>
<record session="session_4" date="9:48 am on 4 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D4:43 D4:44">
Jolene: Thanks, Deb! Your encouragement means a lot to me. I'll definitely stay in touch. Bye, take care and keep shining!

</record>
<record session="session_5" date="9:03 pm on 9 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D5:1 D5:2">

<record session="session_5" date="9:03 pm on 9 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D5:3 D5:4">

<record session="session_5" date="9:03 pm on 9 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D5:5 D5:6">

<record session="session_15" date="7:37 pm on 9 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D15:17 D15:18">

<record session="session_15" date="7:37 pm on 9 July, 2023" dialogue_ids="D15:19 D15:20">

<record session="session_23" date="11:46 am on 30 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D23:11 D23:12">

<record session="session_24" date="2:14 pm on 3 September, 2023" dialogue_ids="D24:9 D24:10">

<record session="session_6" date="4:12 pm on 22 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D6:5 D6:6">

<record session="session_6" date="4:12 pm on 22 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D6:9 D6:10">

<record session="session_7" date="4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:1 D7:2">

<record session="session_7" date="4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:3 D7:4">

<record session="session_7" date="4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:5 D7:6">

<record session="session_7" date="4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:9 D7:10">

<record session="session_7" date="4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:11 D7:12">

<record session="session_7" date="4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:13 D7:14">

<record session="session_7" date="4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:15 D7:16">

<record session="session_7" date="4:50 pm on 25 February, 2023" dialogue_ids="D7:23">

</record>
<record session="session_8" date="6:17 pm on 19 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:15 D8:16">

<record session="session_8" date="6:17 pm on 19 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:17 D8:18">

</record>
<record session="session_8" date="6:17 pm on 19 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:19 D8:20">
Sam: Wow, Evan! What type of nature do you enjoy painting the most?
Evan: I love painting landscapes. Nature's beauty captivates me and brings me peace. Here's one of my recent works.
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="6:17 pm on 19 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:21 D8:22">
Sam: Wow, Evan! The colors are so bright. How do you capture the tranquil beauty of nature in your paintings?

</record>
<record session="session_8" date="6:17 pm on 19 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:23 D8:24">
Sam: Wow, that pic is great! Do you often spend time in places like this?
Evan: Thanks! I love being in places like this - it brings back memories of road tripping in my trusty car.
</record>
<record session="session_8" date="6:17 pm on 19 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:25 D8:26">

<record session="session_8" date="6:17 pm on 19 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:27 D8:28">

<record session="session_8" date="6:17 pm on 19 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:29 D8:30">

<record session="session_8" date="6:17 pm on 19 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:31 D8:32">

<record session="session_8" date="6:17 pm on 19 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D8:33">

</record>
<record session="session_9" date="10:18 am on 27 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D9:1 D9:2">

Evan: Wow, Sam, great! Glad your new diet/exercise is going well. As for me, I've hit a sore spot lately. Twisted my knee last Friday and it's really painful, so it's been tough to stay consistent with my usual fitness routine. It's really frustrating because staying active is like, mega-important to me.
</record>
<record session="session_9" date="10:18 am on 27 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D9:3 D9:4">

</record>
<record session="session_9" date="10:18 am on 27 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D9:5 D9:6">
Sam: Life sure can be unpredictable and tough. Being adaptable and finding other ways to stay active is key when you're facing an obstacle. Maybe look into low-impact exercises or physical therapy to help with that? And damn, you really got me interested in this book haha!
Evan: Yeah, PT for my knee is on the cards. Hopefully I'll get an appointment soon. Till then, just keeping it low-key and swimming to stay active.
</record>
<record session="session_9" date="10:18 am on 27 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D9:7 D9:8">

Evan: Yeah, thanks for the push, Sam. Oh, hey, I came across this pic when I was tidying up. I took a road trip last month - the scenery was stunning and nature really chilled me out.
</record>
<record session="session_9" date="10:18 am on 27 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D9:9 D9:10">

Evan: Thanks! I went up to the Rocky Mountains, it was so refreshing! The views were stunning and I felt so relaxed. Do you enjoy road trips and exploring nature?
</record>
<record session="session_9" date="10:18 am on 27 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D9:11 D9:12">

Evan: That's cool, Sam. Nature can be really peaceful. I'd suggest going for more hikes, like I do. It's always been calming and fun. We should definitely do one together sometime.
</record>
<record session="session_9" date="10:18 am on 27 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D9:13 D9:14">
Sam: Sounds like fun! Which lake do you recommend? I'd love to explore some of the local trails.
Evan: Check out this one! It's gorgeous and there are lots of trails nearby. You'll love it!
</record>
<record session="session_9" date="10:18 am on 27 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D9:15 D9:16">
Sam: Wow, it looks great! Is it nearby? What a view!
Evan: It's only a two-hour drive from here, but trust me, it's worth every minute for the incredible views and peaceful atmosphere.
</record>
<record session="session_9" date="10:18 am on 27 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D9:17 D9:18">
Sam: Cool, a day trip's doable. Nature's calling me, so I'm gonna go check it out! Thanks!
Evan: No worries, enjoy your time in nature. Take care! Bye!
</record>
<record session="session_9" date="10:18 am on 27 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D9:19">
Sam: Thanks Evan. Have a good one. See ya!
</record>

<record session="session_12" date="3:09 pm on 8 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D12:15 D12:16">

<record session="session_13" date="4:07 pm on 14 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D13:5 D13:6">

</record>
<record session="session_13" date="4:07 pm on 14 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D13:9 D13:10">

<record session="session_13" date="4:07 pm on 14 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D13:11 D13:12">

<record session="session_13" date="4:07 pm on 14 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D13:15 D13:16">

Sam: Thanks, Evan! I'm looking forward to it!
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="1:50 pm on 17 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:1 D14:2">
Sam: Hey Evan! I've been missing our chats. I had quite the health scare last weekend - ended up in the ER with a severe stomachache. Turns out, it was gastritis, which was pretty alarming. It was a wake-up call for me to start prioritizing my health, like adopting a more nutritious diet and getting regular exercise. On top of that, my phone's been giving me a hard time, adding to the stress.
Evan: Hey Sam, sorry to hear about that. Gastritis can be tough. Taking care of ourselves is important. BTW, I've been focusing on fitness and it's been really beneficial for my overall well-being. Funny thing, I had another encounter with a lost tourist recently. Seems like helping tourists is becoming a recurring theme in my life!
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="1:50 pm on 17 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:3 D14:4">

Evan: Yup, Sam! Set some goals, like a certain distance to run or number of push-ups to do. It'll give you something to strive for and stay motivated. Also, try to find an exercise that you enjoy and maybe even get a buddy for extra fun and accountability. Sound good?
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="1:50 pm on 17 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:5 D14:6">

</record>
<record session="session_14" date="1:50 pm on 17 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:7 D14:8">

Evan: Definitely, Sam! Hiking is an awesome way to bond with nature and push ourselves. It's gonna be a cool memory for us both. It's great to see progress, was just at the gym yesterday. Gaining strength!
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="1:50 pm on 17 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:9 D14:10">
Sam: Super excited to get fit with ya. Let's hit the trails soon!
Evan: Thanks, Sam! That's so nice of you. We'll definitely have a great time on our hike!
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="1:50 pm on 17 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:11 D14:12">
Sam: Totally! I'm so pumped for this hike. Connecting with nature is exactly what I need. Thanks so much for the support and always being there. Means a lot.
Evan: Sure thing! Our hike is going to be awesome, I can tell. I'm always here to support you.
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="1:50 pm on 17 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:13 D14:14">
Sam: Thanks, Evan. I appreciate your support.
Evan: No problem, Sam. Whenever you need support, I'm here for you. Stay safe!
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="1:50 pm on 17 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:15 D14:16">

Evan: Later! Stay safe and don't hesitate to holler if you need anything. Can't wait to hit the trail.
</record>

Evan: I hear you, Sam. It's important to have people who encourage you, but not stress you out. By the way, I just got back from my morning walk. It really helps to start the day actively.

<record session="session_15" date="2:56 pm on 25 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D15:3 D15:4">

<record session="session_13" date="4:07 pm on 14 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D13:13 D13:14">

</record>
<record session="session_13" date="4:07 pm on 14 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D13:15 D13:16">

Sam: Thanks, Evan! I'm looking forward to it!
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="1:50 pm on 17 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:1 D14:2">
Sam: Hey Evan! I've been missing our chats. I had quite the health scare last weekend - ended up in the ER with a severe stomachache. Turns out, it was gastritis, which was pretty alarming. It was a wake-up call for me to start prioritizing my health, like adopting a more nutritious diet and getting regular exercise. On top of that, my phone's been giving me a hard time, adding to the stress.
Evan: Hey Sam, sorry to hear about that. Gastritis can be tough. Taking care of ourselves is important. BTW, I've been focusing on fitness and it's been really beneficial for my overall well-being. Funny thing, I had another encounter with a lost tourist recently. Seems like helping tourists is becoming a recurring theme in my life!
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="1:50 pm on 17 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:3 D14:4">
Sam: Thanks, Evan! Glad you've found that it's been good for you! I totally need to get into it too. Just getting started is hard - any tips for staying motivated? Also, you mentioned another lost tourist? Seems like you're becoming the go-to guy for tourists in need!

</record>
<record session="session_14" date="1:50 pm on 17 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:5 D14:6">

Evan: Awesome, Sam! Getting started will get easier with time. And don't forget it's about feeling good and reaching goals, too. Let's plan a hike soon!
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="1:50 pm on 17 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:7 D14:8">

Evan: Definitely, Sam! Hiking is an awesome way to bond with nature and push ourselves. It's gonna be a cool memory for us both. It's great to see progress, was just at the gym yesterday. Gaining strength!
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="1:50 pm on 17 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:9 D14:10">
Sam: Super excited to get fit with ya. Let's hit the trails soon!
Evan: Thanks, Sam! That's so nice of you. We'll definitely have a great time on our hike!
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="1:50 pm on 17 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:11 D14:12">
Sam: Totally! I'm so pumped for this hike. Connecting with nature is exactly what I need. Thanks so much for the support and always being there. Means a lot.
Evan: Sure thing! Our hike is going to be awesome, I can tell. I'm always here to support you.
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="1:50 pm on 17 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:13 D14:14">

Evan: No problem, Sam. Whenever you need support, I'm here for you. Stay safe!
</record>
<record session="session_14" date="1:50 pm on 17 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D14:15 D14:16">

Evan: Later! Stay safe and don't hesitate to holler if you need anything. Can't wait to hit the trail.
</record>
<record session="session_15" date="2:56 pm on 25 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D15:1 D15:2">
Sam: Morning, Evan. I've been trying to keep up with my new health routine, but it's tough. My family's really pushing for it, and I feel so pressured.
Evan: I hear you, Sam. It's important to have people who encourage you, but not stress you out. By the way, I just got back from my morning walk. It really helps to start the day actively.
</record>
<record session="session_15" date="2:56 pm on 25 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D15:3 D15:4">
Sam: Yeah, it's easier when you have a great support system. Thanks for being there for me.
Evan: No worries, Sam. I'll be there for you. Take it slow and treat yourself.
</record>
<record session="session_15" date="2:56 pm on 25 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D15:5 D15:6">
Sam: Thanks for the reminder to take it easy. I sometimes get impatient with myself when I want results fast, but I gotta be patient.
Evan: Yep, progress takes time. So just take it one step at a time.
</record>
<record session="session_15" date="2:56 pm on 25 October, 2023" dialogue_ids="D15:7 D15:8">
Sam: Yes, you're right, Evan. Taking it slow is better than doing too much. I appreciate your support.
Evan: I get it, Sam. I went through a similar phase a twoyears ago. Changed my diet, started walking regularly, things like that.
</record>
<record session="session_17" date="7:30 pm on 21 November, 2023" dialogue_ids="D17:1 D17:2">
Sam: Hey Ev! Long time no chat. How's it going? Hope all is well.
Evan: Hey Sam, good to hear from you! Life's been a wild ride lately. Last week, I had a health scare and had to go to the hospital. They found something suspicious during a check-up, which freaked me out. Thankfully, it was all a misunderstanding, but it made me realize how important it is to keep an eye on my health. How've you been?
</record>
<record session="session_17" date="7:30 pm on 21 November, 2023" dialogue_ids="D17:27 D17:28">
Sam: Take care, buddy. Hang in there!
Evan: Thanks, Sam. If you need to talk, I'm here for you too.
</record>
<record session="session_19" date="1:45 pm on 9 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D19:1 D19:2">
Evan: Hey Sam, hope you're doing good. Wanted to share some amazing news - my partner is pregnant! We're so excited! It's been a while since we had a kiddo around.
Sam: Congrats, Ev! That's great news! Parenthood is so amazing. How are you feeling about it?
</record>
<record session="session_20" date="6:48 pm on 17 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D20:1 D20:2">
Evan: Hey Sam, what's up? Long time no see, huh? Lots has happened.
Sam: Hey Evan! Long time no see. I'm doing okay, been through a few bumps. How about you?
</record>
<record session="session_20" date="6:48 pm on 17 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D20:3 D20:4">
Evan: It's not easy for us right now, my son had an accident last Tuesday, he fell off his bike and it was rough. But he's doing better now. How are you dealing with all this?
Sam: Darn, sorry to hear that. Hope he's feeling better. Same here, it's been tough lately. After we talked, I started thinking about ways to cope with it, but it's been challenging.
</record>
<record session="session_21" date="4:25 pm on 26 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D21:1 D21:2">
Sam: Hey Evan! Long time no see, how's it going?
Evan: Hey Sam! Long time no see! Been up and down lately, got married last week - how about you?
</record>
<record session="session_22" date="11:00 am on 31 December, 2023" dialogue_ids="D22:1 D22:2">
Sam: Hey Evan! I’m really getting into this healthier lifestyle—just took my friends on an epic hiking trip last Friday!
Evan: Hey Sam! That’s fantastic—nothing like a good hike to feel alive. We took the Prius for a long drive to the mountains last weekend. It was perfect until we got into a little scrape on the way back.
</record>
<record session="session_23" date="1:32 pm on 6 January, 2024" dialogue_ids="D23:29 D23:30">
Evan: Sure thing, Sam! Let's see if it lives up to the hype. I'll let you know what happens!
Sam: Yeah, Evan! Let me know all about it. Don't forget the details!
</record>
<record session="session_24" date="12:17 am on 10 January, 2024" dialogue_ids="D24:1 D24:2">
Evan: Hey Sam, hope you're doing good. Something funny happened last night.
Sam: Hey Evan, what's up? What happened? Let me know.
</record>
<record session="session_25" date="9:37 pm on 11 January, 2024" dialogue_ids="D25:1 D25:2">
Sam: Hey Evan, been a few days since we last chatted. Hope you're doing OK. A lot's happened since then. Got issues with my health, it's been rough. Feels like this weight's keeping me from fully living. Trying to stay positive, not easy.
Evan: Hey Sam, sorry to hear about your health. It's tough when it gets in the way of life. You're being positive, but remember to take care of yourself too. By the way, I had to apologize to my partner for that drunken night, it was pretty embarrassing.
</record>

items.block_b:
<record session="session_1" date="1:47 pm on 18 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:1 D1:2">
Sam: Hey Evan, good to see you! What's new since we last met? Anything cool happening?
Evan: Hey Sam! Good to see you! Yeah, I just got back from a trip with my family in my new Prius.
</record>
<record session="session_1" date="1:47 pm on 18 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:3 D1:4">
Sam: Wow, not bad, what happened to the old one? Where'd you go, by the way?
Evan: My old prius broke down, decided to get it repaired and sell it. Glad you asked, we went to Rockies, check it out.
</record>
<record session="session_1" date="1:47 pm on 18 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:5 D1:6">
Sam: Wow! Looks amazing. When did you get to go there?
Evan: We all hiked the trails last week - the views were amazing!
</record>
<record session="session_1" date="1:47 pm on 18 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:7 D1:8">
Sam: Wow, that's cool. I love hiking, but it's been ages since I've done it. I did this hike with my dad way back when I was ten. Going hiking together was great fun, and really special for us.
Evan: Aww, that's cute. How far did you two hike?
</record>
<record session="session_1" date="1:47 pm on 18 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:9 D1:10">
Sam: We hiked a good distance - quite a feat for me back then. It's definitely a great memory.
Evan: What other hobbies have you found for yourself?
</record>
<record session="session_1" date="1:47 pm on 18 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:11 D1:12">
Sam: Nothing so far, but I was thinking about trying painting. Do you have any hobbies you love?
Evan: Cool idea, Sam! I love it. Have you tried it before?
</record>
<record session="session_1" date="1:47 pm on 18 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:13 D1:14">
Sam: Not yet, but I'm keen to give it a go. It looks like a nice way to chill and get creative.
Evan: Yep, it's a great stress-buster. I started doing this a few years back.
</record>
<record session="session_1" date="1:47 pm on 18 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:15 D1:16">
Sam: Wow, that's impressive! How did you get into watercolor painting?
Evan: My friend got me into it and gave me some advice, and I was hooked right away!
</record>
<record session="session_1" date="1:47 pm on 18 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:17 D1:18">
Sam: Wow! I hope I can find something I'm as passionate about as you are with watercolor painting.
Evan: You'll find it, just keep trying new things until something sparks your excitement.
</record>
<record session="session_1" date="1:47 pm on 18 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:19 D1:20">
Sam: Thanks, Evan! I'm excited to try new things, should be fun!
Evan: No worries, Sam! Super pumped for you! Let's catch up soon and see how you're enjoying your new hobbies!
</record>
<record session="session_1" date="1:47 pm on 18 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D1:21 D1:22">
Sam: Yeah, I'll keep you posted. See you soon!
Evan: Take it easy, Evan! Can't wait to see you. Have a good one!
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="7:11 pm on 24 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:1 D2:2">
Evan: Hey Sam, good to hear from you! Since we last talked, lots has been happening! Last weekend, I took my family on a road trip to Jasper. It was amazing! We drove through the Icefields Parkway and the glaciers and lakes were gorgeous. I got a shot of a glacier, check it out!
Sam: Hey Evan, looks amazing! I've never been to Jasper, but it looks breathtaking. Tell me more about your road trip. Was it relaxing?
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="7:11 pm on 24 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:3 D2:4">
Evan: Hey Sam, thanks for asking! It was great - fresh air, peacefulness and a cozy cabin surrounded by mountains and forests made it feel like a real retreat.
Sam: That sounds great, Evan! It's so important to take time for ourselves and find peace, especially after a hard week. Mine's been tough.
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="7:11 pm on 24 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:5 D2:6">
Evan: Sorry to hear that, Sam. Is there anything I can do to help?
Sam: Thanks, Evan. Appreciate the offer, but had a check-up with my doctor a few days ago and, yikes, the weight wasn't great. It was pretty eye-opening.
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="7:11 pm on 24 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:7 D2:8">
Evan: That must have been a challenging experience, Sam. It's tough when we have to confront our own health challenges. Remember, it's never too late to make positive changes for a healthier lifestyle. Is there anything I can do to support you in this journey?
Sam: Thanks, Evan. Breaking old habits isn't easy. Do you have any tips for starting the process?
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="7:11 pm on 24 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:9 D2:10">
Evan: Yeah, what worked for me was finding a fitness routine I really enjoy. It's my go-to, I love the feeling of being healthy and strong. Making it fun and finding little ways to make smarter choices in my diet really added up. Don't forget, you got this!
Sam: Thanks, Evan. Like you said, I've been looking for a hobby to stay motivated. I've been thinking about trying painting. Do you think it will help me de-stress?
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="7:11 pm on 24 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:11 D2:12">
Evan: Of course, Sam! Painting is a great way to relieve stress and be creative. It gives you the freedom to explore colors and textures and express feelings. I've been doing it for a few years now and it helps me find peace. But unfortunately it won't help you with your weight problem, besides painting I recommend exercising!
Sam: Thanks, Evan! Appreciate the encouragement. I'll give it a go and let you know how it turns out.
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="7:11 pm on 24 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:13 D2:14">
Evan: Awesome, Sam! Have fun with it and don't put too much pressure on yourself. Can't wait to hear how it's going!
Sam: Cheers, Evan! I won't stress - just gonna enjoy it.
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="7:11 pm on 24 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:15 D2:16">
Evan: Alright Sam, have fun with it! Keep me updated!
Sam: Thanks, Evan! Will do. Bye for now.
</record>
<record session="session_2" date="7:11 pm on 24 May, 2023" dialogue_ids="D2:17">
Evan: Take care, Sam! I'll catch up with you later.
</record>
<record session="session_3" date="3:55 pm on 6 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D3:1 D3:2">
Evan: Hey Sam! Long time no talk! How're you doing? Life's been quite the rollercoaster lately. I had a health scare last week – a sudden heart palpitation incident that really shook me up. It's been a serious wake-up call about my lifestyle.
Sam: Hey Evan, great hearing from you! Sorry about that, glad you're feeling better now. Trying to eat healthier these days.
</record>
<record session="session_3" date="3:55 pm on 6 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D3:3 D3:4">
Evan: That salad looks yummy! I'm being extra careful with my health lately. I'm trying to eat less processed food and sugary snacks, even though I love ginger snaps. Have you made any changes to your diet recently?
Sam: Nah, no changes for me. Still enjoying my soda and candy, although I know it's not the best habit to have.
</record>
<record session="session_3" date="3:55 pm on 6 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D3:5 D3:6">
Evan: Yeah, breaking habits can be tough. Making small changes can have a big impact later on. Have you considered swapping soda for flavored seltzer water? It's still bubbly and tasty, but without the sugar. And instead of candy, you could try dark chocolate with high cocoa content - it's a healthier option. What do you think?
Sam: Yeah, good idea! I'll give it a try.
</record>
<record session="session_3" date="3:55 pm on 6 June, 2023" dialogue_ids="D3:7 D3:8">
Evan: Awesome, Sam! Let me know how it goes. Making small changes can really help you live a healthier life. Don't forget - every step matters!
Sam: Hey Evan, thanks! Appreciate it. I'll definitely keep you posted.
</record>

<record session="session_6" date="4:09 pm on 13 August, 2023" dialogue_ids="D6:1 D6:2">
